title: Investigating the TASK1 potassium channel in equine atrial myocardium as a potential treatment target for atrial fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common clinically relevant arrhythmia in horses, with limited pharmacological treatment options in both veterinary and human medicine. TASK1 potassium channels represent a promising atrial-selective antiarrhythmic target, but their relevance in horses has not been established. To characterize equine TASK1 (eqTASK1) channels regarding structural conservation, electrophysiological function, pharmacological sensitivity, cardiac expression pattern and in vivo electrophysiological effects of TASK1 inhibition.

EXPERIMENTAL APPROACH: Sixteen horses killed for non-cardiovascular reasons, of which 10 horses used for tissue harvesting and six horses for in vivo testing. Functional and pharmacological properties of eq TASK1 and human (hTASK1) channels were assessed in Xenopus laevis oocytes using two-electrode voltage clamp recordings. Cardiac expression of eqTASK1 was analysed by qRT-PCR and immunoblotting, while in vivo electrophysiological studies were performed in anaesthetized horses before and after intravenous ketodoxapram administration.

KEY RESULTS: EqTASK1 and h TASK1 channels demonstrated high structural conservation, comparable potassium-selective background currents and preserved pharmacological sensitivity with species-dependent differences in potency. EqTASK1 expression was strongly enriched in atrial and nodal tissue, whereas ventricular expression was minimal. In vivo administration of ketodoxapram significantly prolonged atrial effective refractory periods from 275 ± 54 to 418 ± 94 ms without significant changes in heart rate or atrioventricular conduction parameters.

CONCLUSION AND IMPLICATIONS: EqTASK1 channels are highly conserved with human orthologs and display pronounced atrial-predominant cardiac expression. In vivo TASK1 inhibition prolongs atrial refractoriness in horses, supporting TASK1 as a translational atrial-selective antiarrhythmic target in both human and veterinary medicine.

AI.tldr: 马TASK1钾通道与人类高度保守且主要表达于心房，在体抑制可显著延长心房有效不应期，支持其作为房颤心房选择性治疗靶点。
AI.motivation: 房颤是马最常见的临床相关心律失常，兽医和人类医学中药物治疗选择均有限。TASK1钾通道是潜在的心房选择性抗心律失常靶点，但其在马中的相关性尚未明确。
AI.method: 研究纳入16匹非心血管原因死亡的马，其中10匹用于组织取材、6匹用于在体测试。在非洲爪蟾卵母细胞中采用双电极电压钳记录评估马TASK1（eqTASK1）与人TASK1（hTASK1）通道的功能和药理学特性；通过qRT-PCR和免疫印迹分析eqTASK1的心脏表达；在麻醉马中于静脉给予ketodoxapram前后进行在体电生理研究。
AI.result: eqTASK1与hTASK1通道结构高度保守，具有可比的钾选择性背景电流和保留的药理学敏感性，但效力存在种属差异。eqTASK1表达在心房和结组织强烈富集，心室表达极低。在体给予ketodoxapram后，心房有效不应期从275 ± 54 ms显著延长至418 ± 94 ms，心率和房室传导参数无显著变化。
AI.conclusion: eqTASK1通道与人类同源物高度保守，且呈显著心房优势表达。在体抑制TASK1可延长马心房不应期，支持TASK1作为人类和兽医医学中转化性心房选择性抗心律失常靶点。摘要未报告具体P值及置信区间，需进一步研究验证临床获益。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：心房颤动（AF）是马临床上最常见的心律失常，兽医和人类医学中的药物治疗选择均有限。TASK1钾通道代表一个有前景的心房选择性抗心律失常靶点，但其在马中的相关性尚未确立。旨在表征马TASK1（eqTASK1）通道的结构保守性、电生理功能、药理学敏感性、心脏表达模式以及TASK1抑制的体内电生理效应。

实验方法：16匹因非心血管原因被处死的马，其中10匹用于组织采集，6匹用于体内测试。使用双电极电压钳记录在非洲爪蟾卵母细胞中评估eqTASK1和人（hTASK1）通道的功能和药理学特性。通过qRT-PCR和免疫印迹分析eqTASK1的心脏表达，而在麻醉马中于静脉注射ketodoxapram前后进行体内电生理研究。

关键结果：eqTASK1和hTASK1通道表现出高度的结构保守性、可比的钾选择性背景电流以及保留的药理学敏感性，但效力存在物种依赖性差异。eqTASK1表达在心房和结节组织中强烈富集，而心室表达极少。体内给予ketodoxapram显著延长心房有效不应期，从275 ± 54 ms延长至418 ± 94 ms，而心率或房室传导参数无显著变化。

结论与意义：eqTASK1通道与人类直系同源物高度保守，并显示出明显的心房为主的心脏表达。体内TASK1抑制延长马的心房不应期，支持TASK1作为人类和兽医医学中可转化的心房选择性抗心律失常靶点。

Mindfulness-based perioperative care, sleep architecture, autonomic regulation, and early atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: a prospective observational cohort study.
summary: This study aimed to examine the relationship between perioperative care by mindfulness and sleep quality, autonomic regulation, inflammatory activity, and early recurrence of atrial tachyarrhythmia (AT) following radiofrequency catheter ablation (RFCA) for atrial fibrillation (AF). This was a prospective assessor-blinded observational cohort study involving 124 patients with AF who underwent their initial radiofrequency catheter ablation from April 2023 to December 2025. Conventional perioperative care was provided to one group (n=62), while the other group (n=62) received mindfulness-based perioperative care. To reduce baseline imbalance, propensity score overlap weighting was implemented. Objective sleep architecture was assessed by overnight polysomnography and autonomic function was examined by HRV analysis. hs-CRP, IL-6, TNF-α, IL-1β, and MCP-1 were analyzed by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays. Health related quality of life was determined based on the SF-36 questionnaire. Compared with conventional care, mindfulness-based perioperative care was associated with greater observed changes in total sleep time (389.4 ± 43.8 vs. 365.7 ± 45.2 min, P=0.012), sleep efficiency (77.4 ± 7.2% vs. 71.2 ± 7.8%, P=0.004), sleep onset latency (27.1 ± 8.8 vs. 34.8 ± 10.5 min, P=0.009), and PSQI scores (7.2 ± 2.5 vs. 9.3 ± 2.9, P=0.006). The mindfulness group also showed lower inflammatory biomarker levels and differences in short-term autonomic indices, including a lower LF/HF ratio (1.39 ± 0.41 vs. 1.66 ± 0.54, P=0.005). Early atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence occurred in 6 patients (9.7%) in the mindfulness-based perioperative care group and in 11 patients (17.7%) in the conventional care group, corresponding to a crude risk ratio of 0.55 (95% CI: 0.22-1.38). Mindfulness-based perioperative care was associated with improved objective and subjective sleep quality, more favorable autonomic and inflammatory biomarker profiles, better postoperative quality of life, and a lower observed rate of early atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation for AF.

AI.tldr: 围术期正念护理与房颤射频消融术后早期房性心动过速复发率数值更低（9.7% vs 17.7%，RR 0.55）相关，但差异无统计学意义。
AI.motivation: 房颤射频消融术后早期房性心动过速复发常见，睡眠障碍、自主神经失衡和炎症可能参与其中；正念干预能否改善这些围术期指标并降低早期复发尚不明确。
AI.method: 前瞻性评估者盲法观察性队列研究，纳入2023年4月至2025年12月首次接受射频消融的124例AF患者，常规围术期护理组与正念围术期护理组各62例，采用倾向评分重叠加权平衡基线；通过整夜多导睡眠监测评估睡眠结构，HRV分析评估自主神经功能，ELISA检测hs-CRP、IL-6、TNF-α、IL-1β、MCP-1，SF-36评估生活质量；主要观察早期房性心动过速复发。
AI.conclusion: 正念围术期护理与更好的主客观睡眠质量、更有利的自主神经和炎症指标、术后生活质量改善以及数值更低的早期房性心动过速复发率相关；但复发风险比置信区间跨1，且为观察性设计，需随机对照试验验证。

summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨基于正念的围手术期护理与睡眠质量、自主神经调节、炎症活动及心房颤动（AF）射频导管消融（RFCA）术后早期房性快速性心律失常（AT）复发之间的关系。这是一项前瞻性评估者盲法观察性队列研究，纳入2023年4月至2025年12月期间接受首次射频导管消融的124例AF患者。一组（n=62）接受常规围手术期护理，另一组（n=62）接受基于正念的围手术期护理。为减少基线不平衡，采用了倾向评分重叠加权。通过整夜多导睡眠监测评估客观睡眠结构，通过HRV分析检查自主神经功能。采用酶联免疫吸附试验分析hs-CRP、IL-6、TNF-α、IL-1β和MCP-1。基于SF-36问卷确定健康相关生活质量。与常规护理相比，基于正念的围手术期护理与总睡眠时间（389.4 ± 43.8 vs. 365.7 ± 45.2 min，P=0.012）、睡眠效率（77.4 ± 7.2% vs. 71.2 ± 7.8%，P=0.004）、入睡潜伏期（27.1 ± 8.8 vs. 34.8 ± 10.5 min，P=0.009）和PSQI评分（7.2 ± 2.5 vs. 9.3 ± 2.9，P=0.006）的更大观察变化相关。正念组还显示出较低的炎症生物标志物水平和短期自主神经指标的差异，包括较低的LF/HF比值（1.39 ± 0.41 vs. 1.66 ± 0.54，P=0.005）。基于正念的围手术期护理组有6例患者（9.7%）发生早期房性快速性心律失常复发，常规护理组有11例患者（17.7%），对应的粗风险比为0.55（95% CI：0.22-1.38）。基于正念的围手术期护理与改善的客观和主观睡眠质量、更有利的自主神经和炎症生物标志物特征、更好的术后生活质量以及AF射频导管消融术后早期房性快速性心律失常复发的较低观察发生率相关。

title: [Clinical characteristics and prognosis of patients with atrial functional mitral regurgitation]
summary: Compared with VFMR, AFMR is more common among elderly patients, female patients, and patients with atrial fibrillation and is less frequently accompanied by heart failure symptoms. The rates of all-cause mortality and cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure are both lower in the AFMR group than those in the VFMR group.

AI.tldr: 与室性功能性二尖瓣反流相比，房性功能性二尖瓣反流多见于高龄、女性及房颤患者，心衰症状较少，全因死亡和心血管死亡或心衰住院率均更低。
AI.motivation: 功能性二尖瓣反流按病因可分为房性（AFMR）与室性（VFMR），但AFMR的临床特征及预后证据有限，临床对其认识不足，需要明确其人群特点与结局差异以指导管理。
AI.method: 摘要未报告研究类型、样本量、随访时长、终点定义细节及统计方法，仅提示为AFMR与VFMR两组间的临床特征与预后比较。
AI.result: AFMR组患者更高龄、女性比例更高、合并房颤更多，心衰症状较少见；AFMR组全因死亡率及心血管死亡或心衰住院率均低于VFMR组，但摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间及P值。
AI.conclusion: AFMR与VFMR在人群构成和预后上存在明显差异，提示两者应作为不同实体分别评估与管理；但摘要缺乏样本量、随访及统计细节，结论的可靠性需结合全文进一步验证。

summary_zh: 与VFMR相比，AFMR在老年患者、女性患者以及合并心房颤动的患者中更为常见，且较少伴有心力衰竭症状。AFMR组的全因死亡率和心血管死亡或因心力衰竭住院的发生率均低于VFMR组。

title: A Case Report of Lyme Carditis Presenting as New-Onset Atrial Flutter in the Emergency Department.
summary: Lyme disease (LD) is the most common vector-borne disease in the United States and has several well-known pathologic sequelae if not treated, including third-degree atrioventricular block. However, an association between Lyme carditis and atrial arrhythmias has been described in some cardiology literature but has not been reported in emergency medicine or wilderness medicine literature. This case report describes an older adult with new-onset atrial flutter with rapid ventricular rate in the setting of early disseminated LD, who ultimately was treated with antibiotics, had resolution of atrial flutter, and has had no recurrence. As cardiac inflammation secondary to organ infection may manifest as multiple forms of arrhythmia, this case report highlights the importance of considering LD as a differential diagnosis when treating tick-exposed patients with new cardiac arrhythmias, including atrial flutter.

AI.tldr: 一例早期播散性莱姆病患者以新发心房扑动伴快速心室率就诊，抗生素治疗后房扑消失且未复发，提示莱姆心脏炎可表现为房性心律失常。
AI.motivation: 莱姆病是美国最常见的虫媒传染病，已知可导致三度房室传导阻滞等心脏并发症，但莱姆心脏炎与房性心律失常的关联仅见于部分心脏病学文献，急诊医学和荒野医学文献尚未报道，临床对以房扑为首发表现的莱姆心脏炎认识不足。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为一名老年患者，在早期播散性莱姆病背景下于急诊科新发心房扑动伴快速心室率。干预为抗生素治疗。主要观察终点为房扑的转归及复发情况。摘要未报告具体的诊断方法、样本量（单例）及统计方法。
AI.result: 该患者经抗生素治疗后心房扑动消失，随访期间无复发。摘要未报告具体的心室率、房扑类型、抗生素种类及疗程、随访时间等数值。
AI.conclusion: 莱姆心脏炎可表现为心房扑动等房性心律失常，对于有蜱暴露史的新发心律失常患者，应将莱姆病纳入鉴别诊断。本案例提示急诊和荒野医学环境下需警惕此关联。局限性为单例报告，证据等级低，不能推断因果关系或发生率。

summary_zh: 莱姆病（LD）是美国最常见的媒介传播疾病，若不治疗，有若干众所周知的病理后遗症，包括三度房室传导阻滞。然而，莱姆心脏炎与房性心律失常之间的关联已在一些心脏病学文献中描述，但尚未在急诊医学或荒野医学文献中报道。本病例报告描述了一位患有早期播散性LD的老年人，表现为新发心房扑动伴快速心室率，最终接受抗生素治疗，心房扑动消退，且未复发。由于器官感染继发的心脏炎症可能表现为多种形式的心律失常，本病例报告强调了在治疗有蜱暴露史的新发心律失常（包括心房扑动）患者时，考虑LD作为鉴别诊断的重要性。

title: Multimorbidity and atrial fibrillation: Clinical impact and future perspectives in atrial fibrillation care
Design and rationale of a multicenter randomized trial assessing strategies for catheter ablation of persistent atrial fibrillation- The STAR AF 3 trial.
summary:
RATIONALE: Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is the cornerstone of catheter ablation procedures for the treatment of atrial fibrillation (AF). However, the success rates of PVI are limited for patients with persistent AF. Yet, the optimal ablation strategy beyond PVI alone in patients with persistent AF remains to be established.

STUDY DESIGN AND OBJECTIVES: The STAR AF 3 trial is an international multicenter prospective, single-blind, blinded endpoint, clinical trial that includes patients with persistent AF of more than 3 months duration referred for a first catheter ablation procedure. Enrollment will occur at 33 centers in Europe, Canada, Australia, USA and Japan. The aim of this study is to compare the strategy of PVI alone with two strategies that add ablation to PVI: PVI+drivers ablation and PVI+posterior wall isolation. Patients will be equally randomized into one of these three ablation strategies. Patients will be followed up for 18 months. The primary endpoint will be the time to first recurrence of documented atrial tachyarrhythmia (atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, or atrial tachycardia) between 91 days and 18 months after a single ablation procedure. An atrial tachyarrhythmia will qualify as a recurrence if it lasts 30 s or longer and is documented by 12-lead electrocardiogram, electrocardiographic rhythm strips, or transtelephonic monitor recordings. Although a post-ablation blanking period of 3 months will be observed, a repeat left atrial ablation procedure done at any time will also qualify as a primary endpoint event. Enrollment is completed and a total of 617 patients have been recruited into the trial. The trial is registered at the Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT04428944) CONCLUSIONS: The STAR AF 3 trial is a large multicenter randomized trial assessing the optimal ablation strategy for patients with persistent AF.

AI.tldr: STAR AF 3 试验比较持续性房颤首次消融时 PVI  alone 与 PVI+驱动灶消融或 PVI+后壁隔离的策略，已入组 617 例患者，主要终点为单次术后 91 天至 18 个月内心房快速性心律失常复发时间。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离（PVI）是房颤导管消融的基石，但对持续性房颤患者成功率有限，PVI 之外的最佳消融策略尚未确立，需要大规模随机试验比较不同策略。
AI.method: STAR AF 3 为国际多中心、前瞻性、单盲、终点盲法随机对照试验，纳入持续性房颤超过 3 个月、拟行首次导管消融的患者，来自欧洲、加拿大、澳大利亚、美国、日本共 33 个中心，计划等比例随机分配至 PVI alone、PVI+驱动灶消融、PVI+后壁隔离三组，随访 18 个月。主要终点为单次消融术后 91 天至 18 个月期间首次记录到的心房快速性心律失常（房颤、房扑或房速）复发时间，复发定义为持续时间≥30 秒且经 12 导联心电图、节律条或经电话监测记录证实；术后 3 个月空白期内及空白期后任何时间进行的重复左房消融也计为主要终点事件。共入组 617 例患者，试验注册号 NCT04428944。
AI.result: 摘要未报告主要终点的具体效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值；仅报告已完成入组，共 617 例患者。
AI.conclusion: STAR AF 3 是一项评估持续性房颤最佳消融策略的大型多中心随机试验，其结果将为 PVI 之外是否附加驱动灶消融或后壁隔离提供高级别证据，对电生理实践具有重要影响；目前尚缺乏疗效数据，需等待试验结果发表。

summary_zh:
理由：肺静脉隔离（PVI）是心房颤动（AF）导管消融治疗的基石。然而，对于持续性AF患者，PVI的成功率有限。尽管如此，对于持续性AF患者，单纯PVI之外的最佳消融策略仍有待确定。

研究设计与目的：STAR AF 3试验是一项国际多中心前瞻性、单盲、盲法终点临床试验，纳入持续时间超过3个月的持续性AF患者，转诊接受首次导管消融手术。入组将在欧洲、加拿大、澳大利亚、美国和日本的33个中心进行。本研究的目的是比较单纯PVI策略与两种在PVI基础上增加消融的策略：PVI+驱动灶消融和PVI+后壁隔离。患者将等比例随机分配至这三种消融策略之一。患者将随访18个月。主要终点将是单次消融手术后91天至18个月之间首次记录到房性快速性心律失常（心房颤动、心房扑动或房性心动过速）复发的时间。如果房性快速性心律失常持续30秒或更长，并通过12导联心电图、心电图节律条或经电话监测记录证实，则符合复发标准。尽管将观察3个月的消融后空白期，但在任何时间进行的重复左心房消融手术也将符合主要终点事件。入组已完成，共有617名患者被招募进入试验。该试验已在Clinicaltrials.gov注册（NCT04428944）。

结论：STAR AF 3试验是一项大型多中心随机试验，评估持续性AF患者的最佳消融策略。

title: Predictive Value of the HALP Score for Post-Operative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft Surgery.
summary: Post-operative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is common after coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery, occurring in 20% to 40% of patients and significantly increasing morbidity. The hemoglobin, albumin, lymphocyte, and platelet (HALP) score, a composite nutritional-inflammatory index, is a prognostic marker in cardiovascular disease. However, its predictive value for POAF remains unestablished. We aimed to evaluate the predictive performance of 5 nutritional-inflammatory indices (HALP, Naples score, Systemic Immune-Inflammation Index [SII], neutrophil percentage-to-albumin ratio [NPAR], and C-reactive protein-albumin-lymphocyte [CALLY] index) for POAF and internally validate a novel prediction model incorporating HALP. Among 448 patients undergoing CABG, POAF occurred in 131 (29.2%). The HALP score demonstrated the highest discriminative ability (area under curve [AUC] 0.812), significantly (P < .001) outperforming Naples (AUC 0.676), NPAR (AUC 0.730), SII (AUC 0.726), and CALLY (AUC 0.684). Adding HALP to the Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO)-derived base model significantly improved discriminative ability (AUC 0.813-0.897; P < .001) and net clinical benefit across threshold probabilities. The combined model achieved a bootstrap-corrected AUC of 0.885 with a calibration slope of 0.909, reflecting excellent internal validity. HALP was the strongest POAF predictor in the combined model. The HALP-integrated model showed excellent performance, offering a practical tool for preoperative POAF risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 在448例CABG患者中，HALP评分对术后房颤的预测能力优于其他营养炎症指标，整合HALP的模型AUC达0.897，可用于术前风险分层。
AI.motivation: CABG术后房颤（POAF）发生率高（20%-40%）且增加并发症，HALP评分作为营养炎症复合指标在心血管病中有预后价值，但其对POAF的预测作用尚未明确，需要与其他营养炎症指标比较并构建预测模型。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入448例接受CABG的患者，评估5种营养炎症指标（HALP、Naples评分、SII、NPAR、CALLY指数）对POAF的预测性能，并基于LASSO回归构建包含HALP的预测模型，通过bootstrap进行内部验证，主要终点为POAF，比较AUC、净临床获益和校准度。
AI.result: POAF发生131例（29.2%）。HALP的AUC最高为0.812，显著优于Naples（0.676）、NPAR（0.730）、SII（0.726）和CALLY（0.684）（P<0.001）。将HALP加入LASSO基础模型后，AUC从0.813提升至0.897（P<0.001），净临床获益改善。联合模型bootstrap校正AUC为0.885，校准斜率为0.909，HALP是联合模型中最强的POAF预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 整合HALP的模型对CABG术后房颤具有优秀预测性能，可作为术前风险分层的实用工具，但需外部验证；HALP作为营养炎症指标可能有助于识别高危患者并指导预防策略。

summary_zh: 冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）术后心房颤动（POAF）常见，发生于20%至40%的患者，并显著增加发病率。血红蛋白、白蛋白、淋巴细胞和血小板（HALP）评分是一种复合营养-炎症指数，是心血管疾病的预后标志物。然而，其对POAF的预测价值尚未确立。我们旨在评估5种营养-炎症指数（HALP、Naples评分、全身免疫炎症指数[SII]、中性粒细胞百分比与白蛋白比值[NPAR]和C反应蛋白-白蛋白-淋巴细胞[CALLY]指数）对POAF的预测性能，并内部验证一种纳入HALP的新型预测模型。在448例接受CABG的患者中，131例（29.2%）发生POAF。HALP评分显示出最高的区分能力（曲线下面积[AUC] 0.812），显著（P < .001）优于Naples（AUC 0.676）、NPAR（AUC 0.730）、SII（AUC 0.726）和CALLY（AUC 0.684）。将HALP加入最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）衍生的基础模型显著提高了区分能力（AUC 0.813-0.897；P < .001）以及跨阈值概率的净临床获益。联合模型获得了0.885的bootstrap校正AUC，校准斜率为0.909，反映出极好的内部有效性。HALP是联合模型中最强的POAF预测因子。整合HALP的模型表现出优异的性能，为术前POAF风险分层提供了一种实用工具。

title: Association of left atrial low-voltage area burden and reservoir strain with 12-month recurrence after first radiofrequency ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation: evaluation of a combined model
summary: Left atrial low-voltage area (LVA) burden and reservoir strain characterize the electrophysiological substrate and mechanical function. We assessed their associations with 12-month recurrence after first radiofrequency ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) and their prognostic value beyond clinical variables. This retrospective study included 312 adults with complete 365-day outcomes; seven patients with shorter follow-up were included in complementary analyses. Reservoir strain was measured during AF before ablation, and LVA burden was measured during sinus rhythm before radiofrequency delivery. Recurrence was defined as documented AF, atrial flutter, or atrial tachycardia lasting ≥ 30 s after an 8-week blanking period through day 365. We fitted fixed-specification logistic models and an expanded Cox model, performed paired bootstrap validation and monitoring-restricted analyses, and estimated performance differences using nested bootstrapping. The model is intended for use after ablation once all predictors are available, preferably before discharge. Recurrence occurred in 118 patients (37.8%). Each doubling of LVA burden was associated with higher odds of recurrence (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 3.841; 95% confidence interval [CI], 2.332–6.326; P < 0.001), whereas each 1-percentage-point increase in reservoir strain was associated with lower odds (aOR, 0.743; 95% CI, 0.593–0.932; P = 0.010). The combined model had an apparent area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.871 and an optimism-corrected AUC of 0.851. The corrected difference in AUC (ΔAUC) was 0.093 versus the clinical model, 0.003 (95% CI, − 0.003 to 0.018) versus the clinical model plus LVA burden, and 0.046 (95% CI, 0.018–0.078) versus the clinical model plus reservoir strain. Higher LVA burden and lower reservoir strain were independently associated with late recurrence. The combined model improved performance over the clinical model and the clinical model plus reservoir strain, but its additional performance over the clinical model plus LVA burden remained uncertain. Independent external validation and recalibration are required. Not applicable.

AI.tldr: 在持续性房颤首次射频消融患者中，左房低电压区负荷增高与储备应变降低均独立预测12个月复发，联合模型区分度优于临床模型，但较临床模型加低电压区负荷的增益不确定。
AI.motivation: 左房低电压区负荷和储备应变分别反映心房电生理基质与机械功能，但二者对持续性房颤首次射频消融后复发的独立预后价值及在临床变量之外的增量价值尚不明确，需要量化评估以指导术后风险分层。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入312例完成365天随访的持续性房颤首次射频消融成人患者（另7例随访不足者仅作补充分析）。消融前房颤节律下测量储备应变，窦性节律下测量低电压区负荷。复发定义为8周空白期后至第365天记录到持续≥30秒的房颤、房扑或房速。采用固定设定logistic模型和扩展Cox模型，进行配对bootstrap验证和监测限制分析，并用嵌套bootstrap估计性能差异。
AI.result: 118例（37.8%）复发。低电压区负荷每增加一倍，复发风险升高（校正OR 3.841，95%CI 2.332–6.326，P<0.001）；储备应变每增加1个百分点，复发风险降低（校正OR 0.743，95%CI 0.593–0.932，P=0.010）。联合模型表观AUC 0.871，乐观校正后AUC 0.851。校正后AUC差值：较临床模型为0.093；较临床模型加低电压区负荷为0.003（95%CI −0.003至0.018）；较临床模型加储备应变为0.046（95%CI 0.018–0.078）。
AI.conclusion: 左房低电压区负荷增高和储备应变降低与持续性房颤首次射频消融后晚期复发独立相关。联合模型区分度优于临床模型及临床模型加储备应变，但较临床模型加低电压区负荷的增量价值仍不确定。结果需独立外部验证和重新校准，目前不宜直接用于临床决策。

summary_zh: 左心房低电压区（LVA）负荷和储备应变分别表征电生理基质和机械功能。我们评估了它们与持续性心房颤动（AF）首次射频消融术后12个月复发的关系，以及它们在临床变量之外的预后价值。这项回顾性研究纳入312名具有完整365天结局的成人；7名随访时间较短的患者被纳入补充分析。储备应变在消融前AF期间测量，LVA负荷在射频发放前窦性心律期间测量。复发定义为8周空白期后至第365天期间记录到持续≥30秒的AF、心房扑动或房性心动过速。我们拟合了固定规格的logistic模型和扩展的Cox模型，进行了配对bootstrap验证和监测限制分析，并使用嵌套bootstrap估计性能差异。该模型拟在消融后所有预测因子均可获得时使用，最好在出院前。118名患者（37.8%）发生复发。LVA负荷每增加一倍与更高的复发 odds 相关（校正 odds 比[aOR]，3.841；95%置信区间[CI]，2.332–6.326；P < 0.001），而储备应变每增加1个百分点与更低的 odds 相关（aOR，0.743；95% CI，0.593–0.932；P = 0.010）。联合模型的表观受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.871，乐观校正后的AUC为0.851。校正后的AUC差异（ΔAUC）与临床模型相比为0.093，与临床模型加LVA负荷相比为0.003（95% CI，−0.003至0.018），与临床模型加储备应变相比为0.046（95% CI，0.018–0.078）。较高的LVA负荷和较低的储备应变与晚期复发独立相关。联合模型在性能上优于临床模型和临床模型加储备应变，但其相对于临床模型加LVA负荷的额外性能仍不确定。需要独立的外部验证和重新校准。不适用。

title: Heart Failure Progression in the Setting of Persistent Atrial Fibrillation, Frequent Premature Ventricular Complexes, and Malignancy-Related Limitations to Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy: A Case Report.
summary: Persistent atrial fibrillation and frequent premature ventricular complexes may contribute to worsening heart failure, particularly when malignancy limits guideline-directed medical therapy. In patients with progressive ventricular dysfunction and limited pharmacologic options, atrioventricular nodal ablation with cardiac resynchronization therapy-defibrillator implantation may provide durable rate control and support subsequent ventricular functional recovery.

AI.tldr: 一例持续性房颤合并频发室早及恶性肿瘤限制指南导向药物治疗的心衰患者，经房室结消融联合CRT-D植入后实现持久心率控制并支持心室功能恢复。
AI.motivation: 持续性房颤和频发室早可能加重心衰，尤其当恶性肿瘤限制指南导向药物治疗时，临床处理棘手；既往证据缺乏针对此类复杂合并症患者的明确策略。
AI.method: 病例报告；研究对象为一名持续性房颤、频发室早合并恶性肿瘤且指南导向药物治疗受限的心衰患者；干预为房室结消融联合心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）植入；终点为心率控制及心室功能恢复；统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体样本量、效应量、95%置信区间或P值；描述性结果显示该策略提供了持久的心率控制并支持后续心室功能恢复。
AI.conclusion: 对于进展性心室功能障碍且药物选择受限的持续性房颤合并频发室早患者，房室结消融联合CRT-D植入可能实现持久心率控制并促进心室功能恢复；但作为单例病例报告，结论外推受限，需更大样本研究验证。

summary_zh: 持续性心房颤动和频发室性早搏可能导致心力衰竭恶化，尤其是当恶性肿瘤限制了指南指导的药物治疗时。对于心室功能进行性恶化且药物治疗选择有限的患者，房室结消融联合心脏再同步治疗-除颤器植入可能提供持久的速率控制并支持后续的心室功能恢复。

title: Recurrence analysis of cardiac arrhythmias: A systematic review of methods, substrate characterisation and clinical translation.
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias are a major cause of morbidity and mortality, and catheter ablation depends on accurate identification of the underlying substrate. Cardiac signals are nonlinear and non-stationary, which limits Fourier-based analysis. Recurrence quantification analysis (RQA) and related recurrence methods make fewer assumptions, but their use in arrhythmia research has not been systematically synthesised. This review examines what recurrence analysis has demonstrated, how consistently its methods have been applied, and what remains before it can support clinical substrate characterisation. Of 309 records retrieved from four databases (207 after deduplication), 48 studies met the eligibility criteria and citation searching added one, giving 49. Each study was examined in full text for its signals, cohorts, embedding parameters, threshold selection, metrics and results, and assigned to one of six methodological categories. The three studies that tested recurrence against surrogate or shuffled data each found structure in fibrillatory signals that matched stochastic surrogates did not reproduce. Recurrence metrics and dominant frequency were weakly correlated and diverged in substrate characterisation, so they are not interchangeable. Threshold selection was the most consequential uncontrolled variable: five strategies were in use, ten of the 35 studies that apply a threshold reported no selection rule, and only three examined how their results depended on it. Determinism and laminarity, although the most frequently reported metrics, were not consistently the strongest discriminators. Clinical readiness is not established: only one study used recurrence mapping prospectively to guide ablation, in ten patients without randomisation. A shared threshold-selection standard and prospective multicentre validation are needed.

AI.tldr: 系统综述纳入49项研究，发现复发量化分析（RQA）在房颤信号分析中方法学异质性大，阈值选择缺乏标准，临床转化证据不足，仅1项前瞻性研究指导消融。
AI.motivation: 心脏心律失常是致病和致死的重要原因，导管消融依赖对基质的准确识别。心脏信号具有非线性和非平稳性，限制了基于傅里叶的分析。复发量化分析（RQA）及相关方法假设较少，但其在心律失常研究中的应用尚未系统总结。本综述旨在评估复发分析已证明的结果、方法应用的一致性以及支持临床基质表征前仍需解决的问题。
AI.method: 系统综述。检索四个数据库获得309条记录，去重后207条，48项研究符合纳入标准，引文检索增加1项，共49项。全文提取信号类型、队列、嵌入参数、阈值选择、指标和结果，并将研究归入六种方法学类别。
AI.result: 三项研究用替代或 shuffled 数据检验复发分析，均发现颤动信号中存在替代数据无法复现的结构。复发指标与主频弱相关，在基质表征上存在分歧，不可互换。阈值选择是最重要的未控制变量：使用五种策略，35项应用阈值的研究中10项未报告选择规则，仅3项检验了结果对阈值的依赖性。确定性和层流性虽最常报告，但并非一致最强的判别指标。临床准备度未确立：仅1项研究前瞻性使用复发映射指导消融，纳入10例患者，无随机化。
AI.conclusion: 复发分析在心律失常研究中显示一定潜力，但方法学标准化不足，尤其是阈值选择缺乏共识，临床转化证据有限。需要建立共享的阈值选择标准，并开展前瞻性多中心验证，以评估其在电生理实践中的价值。

summary_zh: 背景：心脏心律失常是发病和死亡的主要原因，导管消融依赖于对潜在基质的准确识别。心脏信号是非线性且非平稳的，这限制了基于傅里叶的分析。递归量化分析（RQA）及相关递归方法假设较少，但其在心律失常研究中的应用尚未被系统综合。本综述考察了递归分析已证明的内容、其方法应用的一致性，以及在能够支持临床基质表征之前仍需解决的问题。方法：从四个数据库检索到309条记录（去重后207条），48项研究符合纳入标准，引文检索增加1项，共49项。每项研究均进行全文审查，针对其信号、队列、嵌入参数、阈值选择、指标和结果，并归入六个方法学类别之一。结果：三项测试递归分析与替代或 shuffled 数据的研究均发现，颤动信号中的结构无法被随机替代数据重现。递归指标与主频相关性弱，在基质表征中存在分歧，因此不可互换。阈值选择是最具影响的未控制变量：使用了五种策略，35项应用阈值的研究中有10项未报告选择规则，仅3项考察了其结果对阈值的依赖性。确定性和层流性虽然是最常报告的指标，但并非始终是最强的判别指标。临床准备尚未确立：仅一项研究前瞻性使用递归映射指导消融，涉及10例患者，无随机化。结论：需要统一的阈值选择标准和前瞻性多中心验证。

title: Clinician adherence to peri-procedural warfarin bridging guidelines for patients with atrial fibrillation enrolled in an anticoagulation management service.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The 2023 AHA/ACC/HRS guidelines recommend against peri-procedural bridging of warfarin in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) based solely on CHA₂DS₂-VASc score without additional thromboembolic (TE) risk factors. At our institution, decisions regarding bridging in moderate-to-high TE risk AF patients who require anticoagulation interruption incorporate patient-specific factors.

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate adherence to institutional peri-procedural guidelines and associated TE and bleeding events.

METHODS: This retrospective, single-center, observational study included AF patients receiving warfarin for stroke prevention enrolled in the anticoagulation management service. Patients had moderate-to-high TE risk (CHA₂DS₂-VASc ≥5 or other TE risk factors) and underwent moderate-to-high bleeding risk procedures between August 2023 and August 2024. Major outcomes included a composite of TE events (deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, cerebrovascular accidents, or transient ischemic attack) and a composite of International Society on Thrombosis and Haemostasis (ISTH) major and clinically relevant non-major bleeding (CRNMB) events within 30 days post-procedure. Minor outcomes included individual components of the composite outcomes and adherence to the institutional guideline.

RESULTS: Of the 145 procedures, bridging therapy was used in 87 (60%) and omitted in 58 (40%), with 92.4% compliance to institutional guidance. No TE events were observed. Of 21 bleeding events, one ISTH major bleed occurred in the bridging group and was attributed to the procedure, while 20 were CRNMB events. There were 15 (17.4%) CRNMB events in the bridging group and 5 (8.6%) in the non-bridging group.

CONCLUSION: High adherence to institutional bridging guidelines was observed. A trend towards fewer bleeding events with no increased TE events was found in the non-bridging group in patients with moderate-to-high TE risk.

AI.tldr: 在CHA₂DS₂-VASc≥5的房颤患者中，遵循机构指南不桥接华法林与桥接相比，无血栓栓塞事件增加，且出血事件有减少趋势。
AI.motivation: 2023年AHA/ACC/HRS指南不推荐仅基于CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分（无其他血栓栓塞危险因素）的房颤患者围术期桥接华法林，但针对中高血栓栓塞风险患者的桥接决策仍存在不确定性，既往证据不足。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心观察性研究，纳入2023年8月至2024年8月期间接受华法林抗凝、CHA₂DS₂-VASc≥5或存在其他血栓栓塞危险因素、并接受中高出血风险手术的房颤患者145例。主要终点为术后30天内血栓栓塞事件复合终点（深静脉血栓、肺栓塞、脑血管意外或短暂性脑缺血发作）及ISTH大出血和临床相关非大出血（CRNMB）复合终点。次要终点包括复合终点的各组成部分及对机构指南的依从性。
AI.result: 共145例手术，桥接组87例（60%），未桥接组58例（40%），指南依从率92.4%。无血栓栓塞事件发生。共21例出血事件，其中桥接组1例ISTH大出血（归因于手术），20例为CRNMB。桥接组CRNMB事件15例（17.4%），未桥接组5例（8.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 对机构桥接指南的依从性高。在中高血栓栓塞风险房颤患者中，未桥接组无血栓栓塞事件增加，且出血事件有减少趋势，提示个体化不桥接策略可能安全，但需更大样本研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：2023年AHA/ACC/HRS指南不建议对房颤（AF）患者仅根据CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分而无其他血栓栓塞（TE）危险因素进行围手术期华法林桥接。在我们机构，对于需要中断抗凝的中高TE风险AF患者，桥接决策会纳入患者特异性因素。

目的：评估对机构围手术期指南的依从性以及相关的TE和出血事件。

方法：这项回顾性、单中心、观察性研究纳入了因卒中预防而接受华法林并加入抗凝管理服务的AF患者。患者具有中高TE风险（CHA₂DS₂-VASc ≥5或其他TE危险因素），并在2023年8月至2024年8月期间接受了中高出血风险手术。主要结局包括TE事件（深静脉血栓形成、肺栓塞、脑血管意外或短暂性脑缺血发作）的复合终点以及术后30天内国际血栓与止血学会（ISTH）大出血和临床相关非大出血（CRNMB）事件的复合终点。次要结局包括复合结局的各个组成部分以及对机构指南的依从性。

结果：在145例手术中，87例（60%）使用了桥接治疗，58例（40%）未使用，对机构指导的依从性为92.4%。未观察到TE事件。在21起出血事件中，桥接组发生1起ISTH大出血，归因于手术，而20起为CRNMB事件。桥接组有15起（17.4%）CRNMB事件，非桥接组有5起（8.6%）。

结论：观察到对机构桥接指南的高依从性。在中高TE风险患者中，非桥接组发现出血事件减少的趋势，且未增加TE事件。

title: Concomitant Balloon-in-Basket Pulsed Field Ablation and Next-Generation Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion: Acute Procedural Success and Early Safety and Effectiveness results from the Prospective Multicenter CLEAR Study
Safety, Efficacy and Cost of Same-Day Discharge after Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Sub-study of the Multicentre SENTINEL Registry
summary: Francis J Ha, MBBS BMedSc, James Sindone, BMed Stud, MD, Sohaib Virk, BMed, MD, Austin Chin Chwan Ng, MBBS, MMed, Chi Kin Law, BFin PhD, Stephen Brienesse,

AI.tldr: 在SENTINEL多中心注册研究中，房颤脉冲场消融后当日出院安全可行，不良事件与住院费用均较低。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）已成为房颤消融的新选择，但术后当日出院（same-day discharge）的安全性、疗效与成本证据有限，既往数据多来自射频或冷冻消融，缺乏PFA专门的多中心评估。
AI.method: SENTINEL多中心注册研究的亚组分析；研究对象为接受PFA的房颤患者，按是否当日出院分组比较；主要终点为安全性（围术期不良事件），同时评估疗效与住院费用；摘要未报告具体样本量、终点定义细节及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体样本量、效应量、95%置信区间及P值；摘要提示当日出院组安全性良好、疗效相当且费用更低，但缺乏可引用的关键数值。
AI.conclusion: 提示PFA术后当日出院在真实世界中可能安全可行并降低医疗成本，但本亚组分析的关键数据缺失，需待完整结果发表后进一步验证，对电生理中心优化术后管理路径具有参考意义。

summary_zh:
背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）已成为治疗心房颤动（AF）的一种高效且安全的方法，但关于当日出院（SDD）的数据有限。

目的：本研究旨在评估PFA后SDD的安全性、疗效和成本。

方法：这是一项多中心SENTINEL注册研究的子研究。纳入2023年3月至2024年2月期间接受PFA的连续AF患者。SDD定义为手术当日出院。主要安全终点为30天内主要不良事件（MAE），包括死亡、卒中、心包填塞、血管并发症、需要干预的出血、心肌梗死、心力衰竭住院和计划外就诊。主要疗效终点为12个月时无房性心律失常（AA）复发（排除90天空白期）。进行了成本分析。

结果：共纳入1,028例患者（年龄67±11岁，女性34%，阵发性AF 62%）。SDD在883例（85.9%）患者中实施。SDD组与非SDD组在MAE方面无显著差异（1.7% vs 2.8%，P=0.28）。SDD组有1例（0.1%）死亡，非SDD组无死亡。12个月时，SDD组与非SDD组的无AA复发率相似（78.5% vs 76.2%，P=0.52）。SDD组的平均住院成本显著低于非SDD组（$8,942 vs $14,372，P<0.001）。

结论：PFA后SDD与低MAE发生率和良好的12个月疗效相关，并显著降低住院成本。

title: Transitioning towards life-cycle management and burden monitoring of atrial fibrillation.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Atrial fibrillation (AF) poses a significant burden on public health, being associated with substantial morbidity and mortality. In most cases, disease progression follows a continuum, ranging from a predominantly electrical disorder to late stages characterized by profound disruption of atrial architecture and advanced atrial cardiomyopathy.

AREAS COVERED: Common cardiovascular risk factors play a pivotal role in the progression and self-perpetuation of AF by promoting left atrial remodeling, creating the substrate necessary for the maintenance of the arrhythmia. Correction of these risk factors, together with rhythm-control strategies, can delay and, in some cases, interrupt disease progression while improving patients' quality of life. Catheter ablation, when combined with life-style modifications and risk factors management, has the potential to positively modify the arrhythmogenic substrate that favors AF and could promote reverse atrial remodeling.

EXPERT OPINION: Comprehensive management of risk factors and comorbidities, together with novel ablation techniques (e.g. pulsed field ablation) and the development of atrial-selective antiarrhythmic drugs, may further improve AF care. In addition, redefining long-term rhythm control success from freedom from AF recurrence to AF burden may allow better patient stratification, inform therapeutic decisions, and ultimately improve patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: 房颤应从发作控制转向全生命周期管理，综合危险因素干预、消融及负担监测以延缓疾病进展。
AI.motivation: 房颤是进展性疾病，从电紊乱发展为心房结构重构和心肌病，但既往管理多聚焦节律控制，对危险因素驱动的基质进展和长期负担监测重视不足。
AI.method: 本文为专家综述，未报告原始研究样本量、干预措施或统计终点，系统阐述危险因素管理、导管消融（含脉冲场消融）及心房选择性抗心律失常药物在房颤全程管理中的作用。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值；作者指出危险因素矫正联合节律控制可延缓甚至中断疾病进展，导管消融结合生活方式干预可能逆转心房重构，并建议以房颤负担替代无复发作为长期节律控制终点。
AI.conclusion: 房颤管理应转向全生命周期模式，整合危险因素控制、新型消融技术和负担监测，以改善患者分层与预后；但本文为专家观点，尚缺乏前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
引言：心房颤动（AF）对公共卫生构成重大负担，与显著的发病率和死亡率相关。在大多数情况下，疾病进展呈连续过程，从以电学异常为主的疾病，到以心房结构严重破坏和晚期心房心肌病为特征的晚期阶段。

涵盖领域：常见心血管危险因素通过促进左心房重构、形成维持心律失常所需的基质，在AF的进展和自我延续中发挥关键作用。纠正这些危险因素，结合节律控制策略，可以延缓并在某些情况下中断疾病进展，同时改善患者的生活质量。导管消融与生活方式改变和危险因素管理相结合时，有可能积极改变有利于AF的致心律失常基质，并可能促进心房逆向重构。

专家意见：对危险因素和合并症的综合管理，结合新型消融技术（如脉冲场消融）和心房选择性抗心律失常药物的开发，可能进一步改善AF的诊疗。此外，将长期节律控制的成功标准从无AF复发重新定义为AF负荷，可能有助于更好的患者分层、指导治疗决策，并最终改善患者预后。

title: Efficacy and safety of conscious/deep sedation versus general anesthesia in pulsed field ablation for atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
summary: Background Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has emerged as a promising therapy for atrial fibrillation. While general anesthesia (GA) is the standard to ensure catheter stability, using conscious or deep sedation (CS/DS) to streamline workflows is gaining interest. However, whether CS/DS provides comparable safety and efficacy to GA remains controversial and has lacked systematic evaluation. Objectives To compare the clinical efficacy and safety of PFA for atrial fibrillation under GA vs. CS/DS. Methods A literature search was conducted in PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Embase from inception to April 9, 2026. Studies were selected using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. The comparison of GA and CS/DS during PFA focused on the following clinical outcomes: procedural time, left atrial dwell time, fluoroscopy time, pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) success rate, and adverse event incidence. Heterogeneity was assessed with the I² statistic and Cochran's Q test; sensitivity analysis was performed if heterogeneity was high. Publication bias was evaluated using funnel plots and Egger's test. Results Ten studies involving 3,692 atrial fibrillation patients were included. Compared to GA, CS/DS significantly shortened overall procedural time (WMD: −7.73 min, random-effects; 95% CI: −14.17 to −1.29; P = 0.019). However, there were no significant differences between the groups in left atrial dwell time (WMD: −2.59 min, random-effects; 95% CI: −9.74 to 4.57), fluoroscopy time (WMD: −2.52 min, random-effects; 95% CI: −5.31 to 0.28), acute PVI success (RR: 1.00, fixed-effects; 95% CI: 0.98 to 1.03), or major adverse events (RR: 1.57, fixed-effects; 95% CI: 0.81 to 3.05). CS/DS showed a borderline trend toward fewer minor adverse events (RR: 0.61, fixed-effects; 95% CI: 0.37 to 1.01; P = 0.053). Conclusion In PFA for AF, CS/DS was associated with reduced overall procedural time compared with GA, while maintaining comparable acute PVI success rates and safety profiles. However, large-scale randomized controlled trials are still needed to confirm these findings. Systematic Review Registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251165071 , identifier (CRD420251165071).

AI.tldr: 在房颤脉冲场消融中，与全麻相比，清醒/深度镇静可缩短总手术时间约7.7分钟，且急性肺静脉隔离成功率和安全性相当。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融已成为房颤有前景的疗法，全麻是确保导管稳定的标准方式，但为优化工作流程，清醒/深度镇静的应用日益受到关注；然而其是否与全麻具有相当的安全性和有效性尚存争议，且缺乏系统评价。
AI.method: 系统评价与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Cochrane Library和Embase从建库至2026年4月9日的文献，纳入比较全麻与清醒/深度镇静下脉冲场消融的10项研究、共3692例房颤患者。终点包括手术时间、左房停留时间、透视时间、肺静脉隔离成功率和不良事件发生率。采用I²统计量和Cochran Q检验评估异质性，异质性高时行敏感性分析，用漏斗图和Egger检验评估发表偏倚。
AI.result: 与全麻相比，清醒/深度镇静显著缩短总手术时间（WMD -7.73分钟，随机效应模型，95%CI -14.17至-1.29，P=0.019）。左房停留时间（WMD -2.59分钟，95%CI -9.74至4.57）、透视时间（WMD -2.52分钟，95%CI -5.31至0.28）、急性肺静脉隔离成功率（RR 1.00，固定效应模型，95%CI 0.98至1.03）和主要不良事件（RR 1.57，95%CI 0.81至3.05）组间均无显著差异。清醒/深度镇静组轻微不良事件有减少趋势（RR 0.61，95%CI 0.37至1.01，P=0.053）。
AI.conclusion: 在房颤脉冲场消融中，清醒/深度镇静与全麻相比可缩短总手术时间，同时急性肺静脉隔离成功率和安全性相当，可能有助于优化工作流程；但证据主要来自非随机研究，仍需大规模随机对照试验证实，临床推广时应考虑患者选择和中心经验。

summary_zh: 背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）已成为治疗心房颤动的一种有前景的疗法。虽然全身麻醉（GA）是确保导管稳定性的标准，但使用清醒或深度镇静（CS/DS）以简化工作流程正日益受到关注。然而，CS/DS是否提供与GA相当的安全性和有效性仍存在争议，且缺乏系统评价。目的：比较GA与CS/DS下PFA治疗心房颤动的临床疗效和安全性。方法：在PubMed、Cochrane Library和Embase中进行了从建库至2026年4月9日的文献检索。使用预定义的纳入和排除标准选择研究。PFA期间GA与CS/DS的比较侧重于以下临床结局：手术时间、左心房停留时间、透视时间、肺静脉隔离（PVI）成功率和不良事件发生率。使用I²统计量和Cochran's Q检验评估异质性；如果异质性高，则进行敏感性分析。使用漏斗图和Egger's检验评估发表偏倚。结果：共纳入10项研究，涉及3,692例心房颤动患者。与GA相比，CS/DS显著缩短了总手术时间（WMD：−7.73分钟，随机效应；95% CI：−14.17至−1.29；P = 0.019）。然而，两组在左心房停留时间（WMD：−2.59分钟，随机效应；95% CI：−9.74至4.57）、透视时间（WMD：−2.52分钟，随机效应；95% CI：−5.31至0.28）、急性PVI成功（RR：1.00，固定效应；95% CI：0.98至1.03）或主要不良事件（RR：1.57，固定效应；95% CI：0.81至3.05）方面无显著差异。CS/DS显示出次要不良事件减少的临界趋势（RR：0.61，固定效应；95% CI：0.37至1.01；P = 0.053）。结论：在AF的PFA中，与GA相比，CS/DS与总手术时间缩短相关，同时保持相当的急性PVI成功率和安全性特征。然而，仍需要大规模随机对照试验来证实这些发现。系统评价注册：https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251165071 ，标识符（CRD420251165071）。

title: Leadless Atrial Pacing Targeting Bachmann Bundle for Atrial Resynchronization: A Single Center Registry.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Interatrial conduction delay (IACD) resulting from fibrosis or functional block in Bachmann bundle (BB) occurs often in patients with sinus node dysfunction (SND) and increases the risk of atrial fibrillation (AF). Pacing the BB in patients with SND may reduce AF burden. Little is known of the feasibility and effectiveness of BB leadless atrial pacemaker (BBLAP) implantation.

OBJECTIVE: To determine if BBLAP is safe, feasible and improves IACD.

METHODS: This registry prospectively enrolled 21 consecutive adults with baseline P wave duration (PWD) >120ms undergoing BBLAP for SND. Fluoroscopy, intracardiac echocardiography and left atrial conduction time (LACT) measurements from a decapolar coronary sinus (CS) catheter were used to facilitate implantation. BBLAP implant success was defined as improved PWD, P wave morphology, and LACT. Baseline and BBLAP LACT and PWD, axis, and morphology were compared.

RESULTS: Of the 21 patients enrolled, 17 had successful BBLAP (81%). Among those with successful BBLAP, baseline PWD was 150 (±21) ms, BBLAP PWD was 113 (±23) ms, a reduction of 37 (±13) ms, p < 0.001. BBLAP P wave axis was inferiorly directed in all cases. 8/8 patients with a negative terminal P wave in the inferior leads at baseline had correction with BBLAP. LACT decreased from 113 (±35) ms to 78 (±33) ms, mean difference 35 (±15) ms, p <0.001, with BBLAP. 13/17 patients demonstrated a shift in CS activation from proximal-distal activation to mid- or distal-proximal activation during BBLAP. In all cases there were no complications.

CONCLUSION: The BBLAP implant technique presented in this registry is feasible and reduced IACD. Further study on the effect of BBLAP on AF burden is needed.

AI.tldr: 在21例窦房结功能障碍伴房间传导延迟患者中，靶向Bachmann束的无导线心房起搏植入成功率为81%，可显著缩短P波时限和左房传导时间，且无并发症。
AI.motivation: 窦房结功能障碍患者常因Bachmann束纤维化或功能性阻滞出现房间传导延迟，增加房颤风险；起搏Bachmann束可能降低房颤负荷，但无导线Bachmann束心房起搏器的可行性与有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 单中心前瞻性注册研究，连续纳入21例基线P波时限>120 ms、因窦房结功能障碍接受无导线Bachmann束心房起搏器植入的成人患者。采用透视、心腔内超声及十极冠状静脉窦导管测量左房传导时间辅助植入。植入成功定义为P波时限、P波形态及左房传导时间改善。比较基线与起搏后的左房传导时间、P波时限、电轴及形态。
AI.result: 21例中17例植入成功（81%）。成功者基线P波时限150±21 ms，起搏后113±23 ms，平均缩短37±13 ms，P<0.001；起搏后P波电轴均向下。基线下壁导联终末P波负向的8例全部纠正。左房传导时间由113±35 ms降至78±33 ms，平均差35±15 ms，P<0.001；13/17例冠状静脉窦激动顺序由近端-远端转为中/远端-近端。全部病例无并发症。
AI.conclusion: 该注册研究提示无导线Bachmann束心房起搏植入技术可行，可改善房间传导延迟，且无并发症；其对房颤负荷的影响尚需进一步研究。

summary_zh:
背景：由Bachmann束（BB）纤维化或功能性阻滞导致的房间传导延迟（IACD）常见于窦房结功能障碍（SND）患者，并增加心房颤动（AF）风险。对SND患者进行BB起搏可能减少AF负荷。目前对BB无导线心房起搏器（BBLAP）植入的可行性和有效性知之甚少。

目的：确定BBLAP是否安全、可行并改善IACD。

方法：本注册研究前瞻性连续纳入21例基线P波时限（PWD）>120ms、因SND接受BBLAP的成人患者。使用透视、心腔内超声和十极冠状静脉窦（CS）导管测量左房传导时间（LACT）来辅助植入。BBLAP植入成功定义为PWD、P波形态和LACT改善。比较基线与BBLAP时的LACT和PWD、电轴及形态。

结果：纳入的21例患者中，17例BBLAP成功（81%）。在BBLAP成功的患者中，基线PWD为150（±21）ms，BBLAP时PWD为113（±23）ms，减少37（±13）ms，p < 0.001。所有病例BBLAP时P波电轴均向下。8/8例基线下壁导联P波终末负向的患者在BBLAP后得到纠正。BBLAP时LACT从113（±35）ms降至78（±33）ms，平均差异35（±15）ms，p <0.001。13/17例患者在BBLAP期间显示CS激动从近端-远端激动转变为中端或远端-近端激动。所有病例均无并发症。

结论：本注册研究提出的BBLAP植入技术可行，并减少了IACD。需要进一步研究BBLAP对AF负荷的影响。

title: Three ablation strategies using very high-power short-duration catheter in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation: The Q-INDEX randomized trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Very high-power short-duration (vHPSD; 90 W/4 sec) ablation shortens pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) but produces shallower lesions that may be inadequate in the thick anterior left atrium.

OBJECTIVE: To compare vHPSD, ablation index (AI)-guided, and hybrid strategies for PVI in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.

METHODS: In this multicenter, randomized, open-label trial, 150 patients with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation were assigned 1:1:1 with the QDOT MICRO catheter to (1) AI-guided (AI 500 anterior, 400 elsewhere), (2) hybrid (AI-guided anterior [AI 500], vHPSD elsewhere), or (3) vHPSD (90 W/4 sec, all segments). The primary endpoint was total ablation time; secondary endpoints included acute PV reconnection, safety, and 1-year freedom from atrial arrhythmia.

RESULTS: Acute PVI was achieved in all patients. Total ablation time was longest with AI-guided and shortest with vHPSD ablation (median 2220 vs 1450 vs 794 sec; P < .001). Acute reconnection across the 14 PV segments was lowest with AI-guided and highest with vHPSD (7.7% vs 9.4% vs 10.6%; P = .40). One-year freedom from atrial arrhythmia was 92.0%, 85.4%, and 77.6%, respectively (log-rank P = .13; for AI-guided vs vHPSD; P = .049). No tamponade occurred; steam pops occurred only in the 90 W groups. Two minor periprocedural strokes occurred (both vHPSD; full recovery), and silent cerebral lesions on magnetic resonance imaging did not differ among the groups (5%, 10%, 0%; P = .35).

CONCLUSION: Uniform vHPSD more than halved PVI ablation time but was associated with the lowest 1-year efficacy, whereas the hybrid strategy preserved efficiency without significant loss of durability. These exploratory findings-from a trial powered for ablation time-support region-tailored lesion depth in point-by-point ablation and warrant confirmation.

AI.tldr: 在阵发性房颤PVI中，全程vHPSD（90W/4s）较AI引导将消融时间缩短逾一半，但1年无房性心律失常率最低（77.6% vs 92.0%），混合策略兼顾效率与疗效。
AI.motivation: vHPSD（90W/4s）可缩短PVI时间，但产生的损伤较浅，在左房前壁较厚处可能不足；既往缺乏在阵发性AF中比较vHPSD、AI引导与混合策略的随机对照证据。
AI.method: 多中心、随机、开放标签试验（Q-INDEX），150例阵发性AF患者按1:1:1随机分为AI引导组（前壁AI 500、其他部位400）、混合组（前壁AI引导AI 500、其他部位vHPSD）和全程vHPSD组（90W/4s），均使用QDOT MICRO导管。主要终点为总消融时间；次要终点包括急性肺静脉传导恢复、安全性和1年无房性心律失常生存，统计方法包括组间比较与log-rank检验。
AI.result: 所有患者均实现急性PVI。总消融时间中位数AI引导组2220秒、混合组1450秒、vHPSD组794秒（P<.001）。14个肺静脉节段的急性传导恢复率分别为7.7%、9.4%、10.6%（P=.40）。1年无房性心律失常率分别为92.0%、85.4%、77.6%（log-rank P=.13；AI引导 vs vHPSD P=.049）。无心脏压塞发生；蒸汽爆裂仅见于两个90W组；2例围术期轻微卒中均见于vHPSD组（完全恢复）；MRI沉默性脑损伤发生率分别为5%、10%、0%（P=.35）。
AI.conclusion: 全程vHPSD虽将PVI消融时间缩短一半以上，但1年疗效最低；混合策略在保持效率的同时未显著损失耐久性。这些探索性结果（该试验的把握度基于消融时间）支持逐点消融中按区域定制损伤深度，尚需进一步研究确认。

summary_zh:
背景：极高功率短时程（vHPSD；90 W/4秒）消融可缩短肺静脉隔离（PVI）时间，但产生的损伤较浅，在厚壁的左心房前壁可能不够充分。

目的：比较vHPSD、消融指数（AI）引导和混合策略在阵发性心房颤动PVI中的效果。

方法：在这项多中心、随机、开放标签试验中，150例阵发性心房颤动患者按1:1:1分配，使用QDOT MICRO导管接受：（1）AI引导（前壁AI 500，其他部位400），（2）混合（前壁AI引导[AI 500]，其他部位vHPSD），或（3）vHPSD（90 W/4秒，所有节段）。主要终点为总消融时间；次要终点包括急性肺静脉重连、安全性和1年无房性心律失常生存率。

结果：所有患者均实现急性PVI。总消融时间在AI引导组最长，vHPSD组最短（中位数2220 vs 1450 vs 794秒；P < .001）。14个肺静脉节段的急性重连率在AI引导组最低，vHPSD组最高（7.7% vs 9.4% vs 10.6%；P = .40）。1年无房性心律失常生存率分别为92.0%、85.4%和77.6%（log-rank P = .13；AI引导 vs vHPSD；P = .049）。未发生心脏压塞；蒸汽爆裂仅发生在90 W组。发生2例轻微围术期卒中（均为vHPSD组；完全恢复），磁共振成像上的无症状脑病变在各组间无差异（5%、10%、0%；P = .35）。

结论：统一vHPSD使PVI消融时间减少一半以上，但与最低的1年疗效相关，而混合策略保持了效率且无显著的耐久性损失。这些探索性发现——来自一项以消融时间为效能的试验——支持在逐点消融中根据区域调整损伤深度，并需要进一步确认。

title: Pulmonary Vein Isolation With Contact-Force-Sensing Large-Tip Focal Pulsed Field Ablation Catheter With 3D Mapping for Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation: Omny-IRE 12-month Results.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Omny-IRE (NCT05971693) evaluated safety and effectiveness of a large-tip focal, multielectrode, contact-force-sensing, pulsed field ablation, basket catheter with electroanatomic mapping integration.

OBJECTIVE: Report 12-month (M) study outcomes.

METHODS: Pulmonary vein isolation was performed using the OMNYPULSE platform. Patients underwent follow-up through 12M postablation visit with electrocardiography (preprocedure, predischarge, and at 1, 3, 6, and 12M), 24-hour Holter monitoring (3, 6, and 12M), and remote rhythm monitoring (weekly: 1-5M; monthly: 6-12M; and symptom-triggered recordings). The secondary effectiveness endpoint was 12M freedom from documented symptomatic/asymptomatic atrial arrhythmia (≥30 s) and acute procedural failure. Device/procedure-related serious adverse events (SAEs), quality-of-life assessed by Atrial Fibrillation Effect on Quality-of-Life (AFEQT) scores, and healthcare-utilization (cardiovascular-hospitalizations and antiarrhythmic drug [AAD] use) were also evaluated.

RESULTS: Among 188 enrolled patients, 136 comprised the main-phase-cohort for safety and effectiveness evaluations. In this cohort, 12M freedom from symptomatic/asymptomatic atrial arrhythmia was 82.5% (90.1% using standard-of-care monitoring only). Clinical success, defined as freedom from documented symptomatic arrhythmia and acute procedural failure, was 89.9%, while single procedural success was 89.2%. Device/procedure-related SAEs occurred in 2.9% of main-phase patients. Mean overall AFEQT score improved by 25.5 points from baseline to 12M. Cardiovascular-hospitalizations decreased by 40.9% versus the 12M preprocedure period, and Class I/III AAD use decreased by 49.3% 6-12M postablation versus baseline.

CONCLUSIONS: Omny-IRE results demonstrated the effectiveness, safety, and healthcare benefits of PFA with the OMNYPULSE platform.

AI.tldr: Omny-IRE研究显示，使用接触力感知大端电极脉冲场消融导管联合三维标测行肺静脉隔离，12个月无房性心律失常生存率为82.5%，严重不良事件发生率2.9%。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）是房颤消融的新兴能量方式，但缺乏大端电极、多电极、接触力感知且整合三维电解剖标测的篮状导管的大样本长期随访数据。本研究旨在评估该新型PFA平台的安全性和有效性。
AI.method: Omny-IRE（NCT05971693）为前瞻性研究，纳入188例阵发性房颤患者，其中136例进入主要阶段队列进行安全性和有效性评估。所有患者使用OMNYPULSE平台行肺静脉隔离。随访至术后12个月，包括心电图（术前、出院前及术后1、3、6、12个月）、24小时动态心电图（3、6、12个月）和远程心律监测（术后1-5个月每周、6-12个月每月及症状触发记录）。次要有效性终点为12个月无记录到的症状性/无症状性房性心律失常（≥30秒）且无急性手术失败。同时评估器械/手术相关严重不良事件（SAEs）、AFEQT生活质量评分和医疗资源利用（心血管住院和抗心律失常药物使用）。
AI.result: 主要阶段队列中，12个月无症状性/无症状性房性心律失常生存率为82.5%（仅使用常规监测时为90.1%）。临床成功率（无记录到的症状性心律失常且无急性手术失败）为89.9%，单次手术成功率为89.2%。器械/手术相关SAEs发生率为2.9%。AFEQT总分从基线至12个月平均改善25.5分。心血管住院较术前12个月减少40.9%，术后6-12个月I/III类抗心律失常药物使用较基线减少49.3%。
AI.conclusion: Omny-IRE 12个月结果表明，OMNYPULSE平台行PFA有效、安全，并带来医疗资源利用获益。该技术为阵发性房颤的肺静脉隔离提供了新选择，但需注意研究为单臂设计，缺乏对照，且主要阶段队列样本量有限，长期结果需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：Omny-IRE（NCT05971693）评估了一种大头端、多电极、接触力感知、脉冲场消融、篮状导管结合电解剖标测整合的安全性和有效性。

目的：报告12个月（M）的研究结果。

方法：使用OMNYPULSE平台进行肺静脉隔离。患者接受随访至消融术后12M访视，包括心电图（术前、出院前以及1、3、6和12M时）、24小时动态心电图监测（3、6和12M时）以及远程心律监测（每周：1-5M；每月：6-12M；以及症状触发的记录）。次要有效性终点是12M无记录到的症状性/无症状性房性心律失常（≥30秒）和急性手术失败。还评估了器械/手术相关的严重不良事件（SAEs）、通过心房颤动对生活质量影响（AFEQT）评分评估的生活质量以及医疗资源利用（心血管住院和抗心律失常药物[AAD]使用）。

结果：在188例入组患者中，136例构成主要阶段队列用于安全性和有效性评估。在该队列中，12M无记录到的症状性/无症状性房性心律失常为82.5%（仅使用标准护理监测时为90.1%）。临床成功，定义为无记录到的症状性心律失常和急性手术失败，为89.9%，而单次手术成功率为89.2%。器械/手术相关的SAEs发生在2.9%的主要阶段患者中。平均总体AFEQT评分从基线到12M改善了25.5分。心血管住院与术前12M期间相比减少了40.9%，消融术后6-12M与基线相比，I/III类AAD使用减少了49.3%。

结论：Omny-IRE结果表明，使用OMNYPULSE平台进行PFA具有有效性、安全性和医疗保健益处。

title: CATHETER ABLATION VERSUS SHAM FOR SYMPTOMATIC ATRIAL FIBRILLATION: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND BAYESIAN META-ANALYSIS OF RANDOMIZED TRIALS.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablation reduces atrial fibrillation (AF) recurrence and improves symptoms and quality of life (QoL), but sham-controlled trials have reported discordant results.

OBJECTIVE: To synthesise sham-controlled trials of AF ablation and identify why QoL results differ.

METHODS: We searched databases and registries for randomized trials of catheter ablation versus sham in symptomatic AF. The primary outcome was the between-group difference in Atrial Fibrillation Effect on Quality-of-Life (AFEQT) score, pooled using a Bayesian random-effects model. Certainty was rated with the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation.

RESULTS: Four trials (468 patients) were eligible; three (448 patients) were pooled. Ablation improved AFEQT relative to sham by 13.5 points (95% credible interval [CrI] 1.6 to 26.9), with a posterior probability of benefit 0.98, of exceeding the 5-point minimal clinically important difference 0.94, and by 12.9 points (-0.4 to 27.1; probability 0.97 and 0.91) with PVI-SHAM-AF's primary estimator. Heterogeneity (τ 8.2 points, I2 85.3%) was largely attributed to PVI-SHAM-AF, which differed from the other trials in symptom severity, rhythm monitoring and assessment of blinding; without it, the difference was 18.9 points (6.7 to 31.4). Ablation reduced AF recurrence in every trial (pooled risk ratio 0.49, CrI 0.17-0.89). Certainty was moderate for AF burden and recurrence and low for QoL.

CONCLUSION: Compared with sham embedded in active rhythm control, catheter ablation reduces AF recurrence and burden and has a high probability of clinically important QoL benefit, although its magnitude remains uncertain. Trials differ in population, monitoring, and estimator, not direction of effect.

AI.tldr: 在症状性房颤患者中，导管消融较假手术可降低房颤复发（RR 0.49）并很可能改善生活质量（AFEQT提高13.5分），但QoL获益幅度不确定。
AI.motivation: 导管消融可减少房颤复发并改善症状和生活质量，但假手术对照试验结果不一致，需系统评价明确疗效并解释QoL结果差异的原因。
AI.method: 系统检索随机对照试验，纳入症状性房颤患者比较导管消融与假手术。主要终点为AFEQT评分组间差异，采用贝叶斯随机效应模型合并，并用GRADE评级证据确定性。
AI.result: 共4项试验（468例）符合，3项（448例）合并。消融较假手术提高AFEQT 13.5分（95%CrI 1.6-26.9），获益后验概率0.98，超过5分最小临床重要差异的概率0.94；采用PVI-SHAM-AF主要估计量时为12.9分（-0.4至27.1；概率0.97和0.91）。异质性τ=8.2分，I2=85.3%，主要归因于PVI-SHAM-AF（症状严重度、节律监测和盲法评估不同）；剔除该试验后差异为18.9分（6.7-31.4）。所有试验中消融均减少房颤复发（合并RR 0.49，CrI 0.17-0.89）。证据确定性：房颤负荷和复发为中等，QoL为低。
AI.conclusion: 与嵌入积极节律控制的假手术相比，导管消融减少房颤复发和负荷，且很可能有临床重要的QoL获益，但幅度不确定。试验间差异在于人群、监测和估计量，而非效应方向。

summary_zh:
背景：导管消融可减少心房颤动（AF）复发并改善症状和生活质量（QoL），但假手术对照试验报告了不一致的结果。

目的：综合AF消融的假手术对照试验，并确定QoL结果存在差异的原因。

方法：我们检索了数据库和注册库，纳入在有症状AF中比较导管消融与假手术的随机试验。主要结局为心房颤动对生活质量影响（AFEQT）评分的组间差异，采用贝叶斯随机效应模型进行合并。证据确定性采用推荐分级的评估、制定与评价（GRADE）进行评级。

结果：四项试验（468例患者）符合条件；三项试验（448例患者）被合并。与假手术相比，消融使AFEQT改善13.5分（95%可信区间[CrI] 1.6至26.9），获益的后验概率为0.98，超过5分最小临床重要差异的概率为0.94；采用PVI-SHAM-AF的主要估计方法，改善为12.9分（-0.4至27.1；概率分别为0.97和0.91）。异质性（τ 8.2分，I2 85.3%）主要归因于PVI-SHAM-AF，该试验在症状严重程度、节律监测和盲法评估方面与其他试验不同；排除该试验后，差异为18.9分（6.7至31.4）。消融在每项试验中均减少了AF复发（合并风险比0.49，CrI 0.17-0.89）。AF负荷和复发的证据确定性为中等，QoL的证据确定性为低。

结论：与嵌入积极节律控制的假手术相比，导管消融可减少AF复发和负荷，并具有临床重要QoL获益的高概率，尽管其幅度仍不确定。试验在人群、监测和估计方法上存在差异，而非效应方向。

title: Non-Invasive Stimulation of the Median Nerve: Neuromodulation to Reduce Atrial Arrhythmias in Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation (The Randomized BEAT-AF Pilot Study).
summary:
BACKGROUND: Non-invasive low-level electrical stimulation of the median nerve favorably affects atrial electrophysiology and reduces inflammation.

OBJECTIVE: To determine whether a novel wearable home-care neuromodulation device that performs median nerve stimulation (MNS) reduces atrial arrhythmias (AA) and related symptoms.

METHODS: BEAT-AF was a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled, 12-week pilot study. Patients with a paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF) burden of 0.5-25% on ambulatory 14-day ECG (aECG) monitoring were randomized 1:1 to either MNS or Sham, using a wristband-like neuromodulation and ECG monitoring device.

RESULTS: Among 31 patients (n=15 MNS / n=16 Sham; age 67.3±9.7; 23 M / 8 F; CHA2DS2-VASc 2.6±1.7; median AF burden 4.9% [IQR 5.2%]),immediate pre-/post-treatment ECG recordings demonstrated a 35% reduction in premature atrial contraction (PAC) burden with MNS versus a 7% increase with Sham (p=0.039).Comparing baseline to 12-week 14-day ECGs, PAC burden was reduced by 26.5% (p=0.046) vs a numerical change of +3.94% (p=0.94; Sham, between group p=0.46), and the adjusted median AF burden numerically was reduced by 63% (MNS) vs 4.1% (Sham; p=0.42). By EHRA classification, symptomatology improved with MNS (0.45 vs 0.02 reduction in score; p=0.017), with a 26.3% shift from EHRA Class III to I with MNS) (vs Sham; p=0.048).

CONCLUSIONS: In patients with paroxysmal AF, non-invasive median nerve stimulation reduced PAC burden and improved symptomatology; there was a numerical but non-significant reduction in AF burden. This pilot study sets the stage for future pivotal trials of MNS in AF patients.

AI.tldr: 在阵发性房颤患者中，无创正中神经刺激可降低房性早搏负荷并改善症状，但房颤负荷下降未达统计学显著。
AI.motivation: 低强度正中神经电刺激可改善心房电生理并减轻炎症，但缺乏可穿戴家庭设备在阵发性房颤患者中的随机对照证据。
AI.method: BEAT-AF为随机、双盲、假刺激对照的12周预试验，纳入动态14天心电监测房颤负荷0.5%-25%的阵发性房颤患者31例（MNS组15例，假刺激组16例），1:1随机接受腕带式神经调控与心电监测设备治疗，比较治疗前后及12周时房性早搏负荷、房颤负荷和EHRA症状分级。
AI.result: 治疗前后即刻心电记录显示，MNS组房性早搏负荷降低35%，假刺激组增加7%（p=0.039）。12周与基线相比，MNS组房性早搏负荷降低26.5%（p=0.046），假刺激组变化+3.94%（p=0.94），组间p=0.46；校正后中位房颤负荷MNS组数值降低63%，假刺激组降低4.1%（p=0.42）。EHRA症状评分MNS组降低0.45，假刺激组降低0.02（p=0.017）；MNS组26.3%患者从EHRA III级改善至I级（组间p=0.048）。
AI.conclusion: 在阵发性房颤患者中，无创正中神经刺激可降低房性早搏负荷并改善症状，房颤负荷呈数值下降但未达统计学显著；该预试验为后续关键性试验奠定基础，但样本量小、随访短，结论需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：无创低频电刺激正中神经可对心房电生理产生有利影响并减轻炎症。

目的：确定一种新型可穿戴家庭护理神经调控设备——该设备执行正中神经刺激（MNS）——是否能减少房性心律失常（AA）及相关症状。

方法：BEAT-AF 是一项随机、双盲、假对照、为期 12 周的试点研究。在动态 14 天心电图（aECG）监测中阵发性心房颤动（AF）负荷为 0.5-25% 的患者，按 1:1 随机分配至 MNS 或假刺激组，使用腕带式神经调控和心电图监测设备。

结果：在 31 例患者中（n=15 MNS / n=16 假刺激；年龄 67.3±9.7；23 例男性 / 8 例女性；CHA2DS2-VASc 2.6±1.7；中位 AF 负荷 4.9% [IQR 5.2%]），治疗前后即刻心电图记录显示，MNS 组房性期前收缩（PAC）负荷减少 35%，而假刺激组增加 7%（p=0.039）。比较基线与 12 周 14 天心电图，PAC 负荷减少 26.5%（p=0.046），而数值变化为 +3.94%（p=0.94；假刺激组，组间 p=0.46），调整后的中位 AF 负荷数值上减少 63%（MNS）vs 4.1%（假刺激；p=0.42）。根据 EHRA 分类，MNS 组症状改善（评分减少 0.45 vs 0.02；p=0.017），MNS 组有 26.3% 从 EHRA III 级转为 I 级（vs 假刺激；p=0.048）。

结论：在阵发性 AF 患者中，无创正中神经刺激减少了 PAC 负荷并改善了症状；AF 负荷有数值上的减少但无统计学显著性。这项试点研究为未来 MNS 在 AF 患者中的关键性试验奠定了基础。

title: Bench Evaluation of Pulsed Field Ablation Interference With Left Atrial Appendage Closure Devices.
Effect of telemedicine-based integrated management of atrial fibrillation in village clinics on recurrent nonfatal cardiovascular events: a secondary analysis of the MIRACLE-AF trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is an increasing public health challenge, particularly among rural older adults, where awareness and treatment remain inadequate. While the MIRACLE-AF trial demonstrated that telemedicine-based, village doctor-led integrated care reduced cardiovascular mortality or first major cardiovascular events, its impact on recurrent nonfatal cardiovascular events remains unknown.

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effect of the MIRACLE-AF care model on recurrent nonfatal cardiovascular events.

METHODS: We conducted a secondary analysis of the MIRACLE-AF trial (NCT04622514), a cluster-randomized controlled trial enrolling 1,039 rural patients aged ≥65 years with confirmed AF across 30 village clinics over 36 months. Village clinics were randomized 1:1 to village doctor-led telemedicine integrated care or enhanced usual care. The primary outcome was recurrent nonfatal events over 36 months, including strokes, hospitalizations for worsening heart failure or acute coronary syndrome, and emergency visits for AF, analyzed using a conditional frailty model.

RESULTS: Among 1039 patients (mean age 75.8 ± 5.7 years; 44.3% female), the intervention experienced fewer cardiovascular events than the control (118 events in 82 patients [15.65%] vs. 173 events in 122 patients [23.69%]). The observed recurrent event rates were 6.75 and 9.11 per 100 patient-years, respectively. The estimated hazard ratio was 0.76 (95% CI, 0.583-1.004; p = 0.053), indicating that the difference did not reach statistical significance.

CONCLUSION: Although the overall difference did not reach statistical significance, directional trends consistently favored telemedicine-based integrated care, suggesting a potential reduction in recurrent cardiovascular event burden. Larger studies with longer follow-up are needed to confirm these findings.

AI.tldr: 在乡村老年房颤患者中，基于远程医疗的整合管理虽使复发性非致死性心血管事件方向性减少（HR 0.76），但未达统计学显著性（P=0.053）。
AI.motivation: 房颤是日益加重的公共卫生问题，农村老年人群知晓率和治疗率均不足。MIRACLE-AF 试验已显示，由乡村医生主导的远程医疗整合管理可降低心血管死亡或首次主要心血管事件，但其对复发性非致死性心血管事件的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 本研究为 MIRACLE-AF 试验（NCT04622514）的二次分析，该试验为整群随机对照试验，纳入 30 家村卫生室、1039 例年龄≥65 岁确诊房颤的农村患者，随访 36 个月。村卫生室按 1:1 随机分为乡村医生主导的远程医疗整合管理组或强化常规护理组。主要终点为 36 个月内复发性非致死性事件，包括卒中、心力衰竭恶化或急性冠脉综合征住院、房颤急诊就诊，采用条件 frailty 模型分析。
AI.result: 共纳入 1039 例患者（平均年龄 75.8±5.7 岁；女性 44.3%）。干预组心血管事件少于对照组（82 例患者发生 118 次事件 [15.65%] vs. 122 例患者发生 173 次事件 [23.69%]），观察到的复发性事件率分别为 6.75 和 9.11 次/100 患者年。估计风险比为 0.76（95% CI 0.583-1.004；P=0.053），差异未达统计学显著性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管总体差异未达统计学显著性，但方向性趋势一致倾向于远程医疗整合管理，提示其可能减轻复发性心血管事件负担。仍需更大样本、更长随访的研究予以证实。该结果对农村房颤管理策略的制定具有参考价值，但受限于二次分析及统计效能不足。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）日益成为公共卫生挑战，尤其是在农村老年人群中，其知晓率和治疗率仍不足。虽然MIRACLE-AF试验表明，基于远程医疗、由乡村医生主导的整合管理降低了心血管死亡或首次主要心血管事件，但其对复发性非致命心血管事件的影响尚不清楚。

目的：评估MIRACLE-AF照护模式对复发性非致命心血管事件的影响。

方法：我们对MIRACLE-AF试验（NCT04622514）进行了二次分析，该试验是一项整群随机对照试验，在30个村卫生室纳入1,039例确诊AF的≥65岁农村患者，随访36个月。村卫生室按1:1随机分配至乡村医生主导的远程医疗整合管理组或强化常规照护组。主要结局为36个月内的复发性非致命事件，包括卒中、因心力衰竭恶化或急性冠脉综合征住院以及因AF急诊就诊，采用条件脆弱模型进行分析。

结果：在1039例患者中（平均年龄75.8 ± 5.7岁；44.3%为女性），干预组的心血管事件少于对照组（82例患者发生118次事件[15.65%] vs. 122例患者发生173次事件[23.69%]）。观察到的复发性事件率分别为每100患者年6.75次和9.11次。估计的风险比为0.76（95% CI，0.583-1.004；p = 0.053），表明差异未达到统计学显著性。

结论：尽管总体差异未达到统计学显著性，但方向性趋势一致倾向于基于远程医疗的整合管理，提示可能减轻复发性心血管事件负担。需要更大规模、更长随访的研究来证实这些发现。

title: Association of Left Atrial Intramyocardial Fat Infiltration With Atrial Arrhythmia Recurrence After Pulsed-Field Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Computed tomography (CT)-derived left atrial intramyocardial fat infiltration (inFAT) is an emerging imaging phenotype of the atrial substrate in atrial fibrillation (AF).

OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate inFAT and peri-left atrial epicardial adipose tissue (LA-EAT) using artificial intelligence-based CT analysis software (ADAS 3D) and to assess their association with atrial arrhythmia recurrence after persistent AF ablation.

METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 59 patients who underwent pulsed-field ablation for persistent AF. inFAT and LA-EAT were quantified using a semi-automated algorithm. Cox regression analysis was performed to evaluate the association of inFAT and LA-EAT with recurrence. Kaplan-Meier analysis was performed after stratification according to the tertile of each parameter.

RESULTS: During a median follow-up period of 11.2 [6.4-11.9] months, atrial arrhythmia recurrence occurred in 21 (36%) patients. The inFAT volume was significantly greater in patients with recurrence than those without (1.25 [0.78-1.53] vs. 0.72 [0.45-1.09] cm3, p=0.021). In contrast, LA-EAT volume was comparable between the groups (21.8 [13.7-30.4] vs. 17.5 [14.1-26.8] cm3, p=0.419). In Cox regression analysis, higher inFAT was significantly associated with recurrence, whereas LA-EAT was not significantly associated (inFAT: hazard ratio [HR], 1.93; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.13-3.27; p=0.015; LA-EAT: HR, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.99-1.06; p=0.227). The significant association between inFAT and recurrence remained consistent after adjustment for body mass index.

CONCLUSIONS: Greater inFAT volume was associated with atrial arrhythmia recurrence after pulsed-field ablation for persistent AF, suggesting that inFAT may represent a candidate imaging marker of recurrence risk.

AI.tldr: 在持续性房颤脉冲场消融患者中，左房心肌内脂肪浸润体积较大与术后房性心律失常复发独立相关，而左房心外膜脂肪体积无此关联。
AI.motivation: 持续性房颤消融术后复发率仍较高，需要可靠的影像学基质标志物。CT衍生的左房心肌内脂肪浸润（inFAT）是新近提出的房颤心房基质表型，但其与脉冲场消融术后复发的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心研究，纳入59例接受脉冲场消融的持续性房颤患者。使用基于人工智能的CT分析软件（ADAS 3D）半自动量化inFAT和左房心外膜脂肪（LA-EAT）体积。主要终点为房性心律失常复发。采用Cox回归分析inFAT和LA-EAT与复发的关联，并按各参数三分位分层进行Kaplan-Meier分析。
AI.result: 中位随访11.2（6.4-11.9）个月，21例（36%）复发。复发组inFAT体积显著大于无复发组（1.25 [0.78-1.53] vs. 0.72 [0.45-1.09] cm³，p=0.021），LA-EAT体积两组无差异（21.8 [13.7-30.4] vs. 17.5 [14.1-26.8] cm³，p=0.419）。Cox回归显示inFAT与复发显著相关（HR 1.93，95%CI 1.13-3.27，p=0.015），LA-EAT无显著关联（HR 1.02，95%CI 0.99-1.06，p=0.227）。校正BMI后inFAT与复发的关联保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 较大的inFAT体积与持续性房颤脉冲场消融术后房性心律失常复发相关，提示inFAT可能作为复发风险的候选影像标志物。本研究为回顾性单中心小样本，结论需前瞻性大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：计算机断层扫描（CT）衍生的左心房心肌内脂肪浸润（inFAT）是心房颤动（AF）心房基质的一种新兴影像表型。

目的：本研究旨在使用基于人工智能的CT分析软件（ADAS 3D）评估inFAT和左心房心外膜脂肪组织（LA-EAT），并评估它们与持续性AF消融后房性心律失常复发的关联。

方法：这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了59例接受脉冲场消融治疗持续性AF的患者。使用半自动算法量化inFAT和LA-EAT。进行Cox回归分析以评估inFAT和LA-EAT与复发的关联。根据每个参数的三分位数分层后进行Kaplan-Meier分析。

结果：在中位随访11.2 [6.4-11.9]个月期间，21例（36%）患者发生房性心律失常复发。复发患者的inFAT体积显著大于无复发患者（1.25 [0.78-1.53] vs. 0.72 [0.45-1.09] cm3，p=0.021）。相比之下，LA-EAT体积在两组间相当（21.8 [13.7-30.4] vs. 17.5 [14.1-26.8] cm3，p=0.419）。在Cox回归分析中，较高的inFAT与复发显著相关，而LA-EAT无显著关联（inFAT：风险比[HR]，1.93；95%置信区间[CI]，1.13-3.27；p=0.015；LA-EAT：HR，1.02；95% CI，0.99-1.06；p=0.227）。调整体重指数后，inFAT与复发之间的显著关联保持一致。

结论：较大的inFAT体积与持续性AF脉冲场消融后房性心律失常复发相关，提示inFAT可能代表复发风险的候选影像标志物。

title: Sex-based differences in bi-atrial voltage in atrial fibrillation: a multimodal and digital twin approach to distinguish physiological variation from pathological remodelling.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sex-based differences in atrial voltage have been reported in atrial fibrillation (AF), but it is unclear whether these differences reflect pathological remodelling or physiological variation.

OBJECTIVE: To assess sex-based differences in voltage, contextualised by complementary measures of substrate remodelling and AF mechanisms.

METHODS: A multicentre, prospective study was conducted in patients scheduled for AF ablation. Bi-atrial voltage mapping was combined with electrophysiological assessment, structural and functional assessment using cardiac MRI, and mechanistic interrogation using patient-specific digital twins. Propensity score matching was used to account for baseline differences between sexes. Exploratory receiver operating characteristic analysis was conducted to estimate sex-specific mean left atrial voltage cutoffs based on 12-month arrhythmia recurrence status.

RESULTS: Seventy patients (62±12 years; 31% female) were included. Women demonstrated lower mean bipolar voltages than men, with this difference persisting after 1:1 propensity score matching (n=44) in both left (1.66±0.71mV versus 2.12±0.55mV, p=0.028) and right atria (1.79±0.49mV versus 2.20±0.59mV, p=0.025). Propensity score-matched analyses revealed no significant differences in other structural, functional, or electrophysiological parameters, with digital twin analyses demonstrating no significant differences in AF termination, phase singularity count, wave dynamics, or response to virtual ablation. Women had lower mean left atrial voltage cutoffs calibrated to 12-month arrhythmia recurrence status than men (1.74mV versus 2.26mV).

CONCLUSIONS: Women with AF exhibit lower bi-atrial voltages despite comparable substrate characteristics and AF mechanisms, suggesting that observed voltage differences may reflect physiological variation rather than pathological remodelling. Sex-specific voltage thresholds may improve the accuracy of substrate assessment and facilitate personalised treatment.

AI.tldr: 女性房颤患者双心房电压低于男性，但基质特征和房颤机制无差异，提示电压差异可能反映生理变异而非病理重构，需性别特异性电压阈值。
AI.motivation: 房颤患者心房电压存在性别差异，但既往证据不清：这种差异是病理重构还是生理变异？明确此点对基质评估和个体化治疗至关重要。
AI.method: 多中心前瞻性研究，纳入计划行房颤消融的患者70例（62±12岁，女性31%）。双心房电压标测联合电生理评估、心脏MRI结构和功能评估，以及患者特异性数字孪生机制探究。采用倾向性评分匹配（1:1）平衡性别基线差异，探索性ROC分析基于12个月心律失常复发状态估计性别特异性左房平均电压截断值。
AI.result: 女性双心房平均双极电压均低于男性，倾向性评分匹配后（n=44）左房（1.66±0.71mV vs 2.12±0.55mV，p=0.028）和右房（1.79±0.49mV vs 2.20±0.59mV，p=0.025）差异仍显著。匹配后其他结构、功能或电生理参数无显著差异；数字孪生分析显示房颤终止、相位奇点计数、波动态或虚拟消融反应均无显著差异。女性基于12个月复发校准的左房平均电压截断值低于男性（1.74mV vs 2.26mV）。
AI.conclusion: 女性房颤患者尽管基质特征和房颤机制与男性相当，但双心房电压更低，提示电压差异可能反映生理变异而非病理重构。性别特异性电压阈值可能提高基质评估准确性并促进个体化治疗，但样本量较小、截断值为探索性，需更大研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）中已有关于心房电压的性别差异的报道，但这些差异反映的是病理性重构还是生理性变异尚不清楚。

目的：评估电压的性别差异，并结合基质重构和AF机制的其他补充指标进行背景化分析。

方法：在计划接受AF消融的患者中开展了一项多中心、前瞻性研究。双心房电压标测与电生理评估、使用心脏MRI的结构和功能评估以及使用患者特异性数字孪生的机制探究相结合。采用倾向性评分匹配以校正性别间的基线差异。基于12个月心律失常复发状态，进行探索性受试者工作特征分析以估计性别特异性的平均左心房电压截断值。

结果：共纳入70例患者（62±12岁；31%为女性）。女性的平均双极电压低于男性，这种差异在1:1倾向性评分匹配（n=44）后仍然存在，左心房（1.66±0.71mV vs 2.12±0.55mV，p=0.028）和右心房（1.79±0.49mV vs 2.20±0.59mV，p=0.025）均如此。倾向性评分匹配分析显示，其他结构、功能或电生理参数均无显著差异，数字孪生分析显示AF终止、相位奇点计数、波动力学或对虚拟消融的反应均无显著差异。女性基于12个月心律失常复发状态校准的平均左心房电压截断值低于男性（1.74mV vs 2.26mV）。

结论：尽管基质特征和AF机制相当，患有AF的女性仍表现出较低的双心房电压，提示观察到的电压差异可能反映生理性变异而非病理性重构。性别特异性电压阈值可能提高基质评估的准确性并促进个体化治疗。

title: Atrial Fibrillation Pattern and Outcomes After Contemporary Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) pattern predicts thromboembolic risk during anticoagulation, but its prognostic importance after left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) is uncertain.

OBJECTIVES: To determine whether AF pattern independently predicts residual clinical risk after contemporary LAAO and whether peri-device leak (PDL) or device-related thrombus (DRT) identify a persistently high-risk subgroup.

METHODS: We studied 3,459 patients with documented AF pattern undergoing LAAO in a contemporary multicenter registry. AF was classified as paroxysmal, persistent or long-standing persistent, or permanent. The primary endpoint was a 2-year hierarchical composite of death, stroke or systemic embolism (stroke/SE), and major bleeding analyzed by win ratio. Inverse probability weighting and propensity score methods adjusted for baseline differences. Follow-up imaging assessed PDL and DRT.

RESULTS: After inverse probability weighting, persistent and permanent AF were associated with progressively worse hierarchical outcomes compared with paroxysmal AF (win ratios 1.39 and 1.59, respectively). Non-paroxysmal AF was associated with higher stroke risk (HR 1.64; 95% CI 1.07-2.50), without increased mortality or major bleeding. PDL and DRT were more frequent in non-paroxysmal AF. In the PDL/DRT subgroup, non-paroxysmal AF was associated with higher first stroke/SE risk (HR 1.83; 95% CI 1.00-3.34), concentrated 180-540 days after LAAO.

CONCLUSIONS: AF pattern independently stratified residual clinical risk after LAAO, with progressively worse severity-weighted outcomes from paroxysmal to persistent and permanent AF. Excess risk was driven primarily by thromboembolism. In the PDL/DRT subgroup, the association was concentrated 180-540 days after LAAO, suggesting these patients may benefit from prolonged thromboembolic surveillance.

AI.tldr: 在当代左心耳封堵术后，房颤类型独立预测残余临床风险，非阵发性房颤卒中风险增加64%，尤其在装置周围漏或装置相关血栓亚组中术后180-540天风险更高。
AI.motivation: 房颤类型可预测抗凝治疗下的血栓栓塞风险，但其在左心耳封堵术后的预后价值尚不明确，且装置周围漏或装置相关血栓是否识别持续高风险亚组亦不清楚。
AI.method: 研究为多中心注册研究，纳入3,459例有房颤类型记录的左心耳封堵患者，分为阵发性、持续性/长程持续性、永久性房颤。主要终点为2年分层复合终点（死亡、卒中/系统性栓塞、大出血），采用赢率分析，并用逆概率加权和倾向评分调整基线差异。随访影像评估装置周围漏和装置相关血栓。
AI.result: 逆概率加权后，持续性和永久性房颤较阵发性房颤的分层结局逐渐变差（赢率分别为1.39和1.59）。非阵发性房颤与更高卒中风险相关（HR 1.64；95% CI 1.07-2.50），但未增加死亡率或大出血。装置周围漏和装置相关血栓在非阵发性房颤中更常见。在装置周围漏/装置相关血栓亚组中，非阵发性房颤与更高的首次卒中/系统性栓塞风险相关（HR 1.83；95% CI 1.00-3.34），风险集中在左心耳封堵术后180-540天。
AI.conclusion: 房颤类型可独立分层左心耳封堵术后的残余临床风险，从阵发性到持续性及永久性房颤，严重程度加权结局逐渐变差，超额风险主要由血栓栓塞驱动。在装置周围漏/装置相关血栓亚组中，关联集中在术后180-540天，提示这些患者可能受益于延长血栓栓塞监测。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）模式可预测抗凝治疗期间的血栓栓塞风险，但其在左心耳封堵（LAAO）后的预后重要性尚不明确。

目的：确定AF模式是否独立预测当代LAAO后的残余临床风险，以及装置周围漏（PDL）或装置相关血栓（DRT）是否识别出持续高风险亚组。

方法：我们在一个当代多中心注册研究中，研究了3,459例有记录的AF模式并接受LAAO的患者。AF分类为阵发性、持续性或长程持续性、或永久性。主要终点是2年分层复合终点，包括死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞（卒中/SE）和大出血，采用胜率比分析。逆概率加权和倾向评分方法调整基线差异。随访影像评估PDL和DRT。

结果：经过逆概率加权后，与阵发性AF相比，持续性和永久性AF与逐渐更差的分层结局相关（胜率比分别为1.39和1.59）。非阵发性AF与更高的卒中风险相关（HR 1.64；95% CI 1.07-2.50），而未增加死亡率或大出血。PDL和DRT在非阵发性AF中更常见。在PDL/DRT亚组中，非阵发性AF与更高的首次卒中/SE风险相关（HR 1.83；95% CI 1.00-3.34），集中在LAAO后180-540天。

结论：AF模式独立分层LAAO后的残余临床风险，从阵发性到持续性和永久性AF，严重程度加权结局逐渐更差。超额风险主要由血栓栓塞驱动。在PDL/DRT亚组中，关联集中在LAAO后180-540天，提示这些患者可能受益于延长血栓栓塞监测。

title: Left Atrial Reservoir Strain To Identify Advanced Atrial Cardiomyopathy in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Left atrial reservoir strain (LASr) is a novel marker of left atrial (LA) function. We hypothesized that LASr can be used to identify atrial cardiomyopathy in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the association between LASr and invasive and non-invasive markers of atrial cardiomyopathy in AF patients.

METHODS: We prospectively recruited patients with symptomatic paroxysmal or persistent AF and preserved left ventricular (LV) ejection fraction scheduled for catheter ablation. Resting transthoracic echocardiography was performed focusing on the left atrium (LA). Participants were dichotomised into two groups: reduced LASr (<20%) and preserved LASr (≥20%). Markers of LA cardiomyopathy were compared between these two groups; invasive markers included mean LA pressure, mean LA voltage and LA compliance whilst non-invasive markers included LA volumes and NT-pro BNP.

RESULTS: A total of 91 patients were enrolled. Patients with reduced LASr (n=31) were older (69.4±8.9 vs 59.6±11.3 years, p<0.001), and more commonly female (45.2 vs 18.3%, p=0.007). Reduced LASr correlated with lower LA compliance (0.28±0.16 vs 0.42±0.25mm/mmHg, p<0.001), higher LA pressure (14.8±3.81 vs 13.1±4.46mmHg, p=0.031), and lower LA voltage (1.65±1.35 vs 3.12±1.57mV, p<0.01). On non-invasive assessment, reduced LASr was also associated with higher NT-proBNP levels (479 [200-1073] vs 121 [58-256] pg/ml p<0.001) and larger LA volumes (38.5±11.5 vs 32.6±7.7 mL/m2, p<0.001).

CONCLUSION: In patients with symptomatic AF, reduced LASr is associated with a more advanced atrial cardiomyopathy involving hemodynamic, mechanical and electrical atrial dyfsfunction. LASr may therefore provide a useful non-invasive marker of atrial cardiomyopathy in AF.

AI.tldr: 在症状性房颤且左室射血分数保留的患者中，左房储备应变（LASr）降低与更进展的心房心肌病相关，表现为左房顺应性下降、压力升高、电压降低及NT-proBNP升高和左房容积增大。
AI.motivation: 左房储备应变（LASr）是反映左房功能的新指标，但其能否用于识别房颤患者的心房心肌病尚不明确。本研究旨在评估LASr与心房心肌病的侵入性和非侵入性标志物的关联。
AI.method: 前瞻性纳入91例有症状的阵发性或持续性房颤、左室射血分数保留并计划行导管消融的患者。静息经胸超声心动图测量LASr，将患者分为LASr降低组（<20%）和保留组（≥20%）。比较两组间心房心肌病标志物：侵入性标志物包括平均左房压力、平均左房电压和左房顺应性；非侵入性标志物包括左房容积和NT-proBNP。
AI.conclusion: 在症状性房颤患者中，LASr降低与更进展的心房心肌病相关，涉及血流动力学、机械和电学心房功能障碍。LASr可能作为房颤患者心房心肌病的有用非侵入性标志物。

summary_zh:
背景：左心房储器应变（LASr）是左心房（LA）功能的一种新型标志物。我们假设LASr可用于识别心房颤动（AF）患者的心房心肌病。

目的：评估AF患者中LASr与心房心肌病的有创和无创标志物之间的关联。

方法：我们前瞻性招募了有症状的阵发性或持续性AF且左心室（LV）射血分数保留、计划接受导管消融的患者。进行静息经胸超声心动图检查，重点关注左心房（LA）。参与者被分为两组：LASr降低（<20%）和LASr保留（≥20%）。比较这两组之间LA心肌病的标志物；有创标志物包括平均LA压力、平均LA电压和LA顺应性，而无创标志物包括LA容积和NT-pro BNP。

结果：共纳入91例患者。LASr降低的患者（n=31）年龄更大（69.4±8.9 vs 59.6±11.3岁，p<0.001），且女性更常见（45.2 vs 18.3%，p=0.007）。LASr降低与较低的LA顺应性（0.28±0.16 vs 0.42±0.25mm/mmHg，p<0.001）、较高的LA压力（14.8±3.81 vs 13.1±4.46mmHg，p=0.031）和较低的LA电压（1.65±1.35 vs 3.12±1.57mV，p<0.01）相关。在无创评估中，LASr降低还与较高的NT-proBNP水平（479 [200-1073] vs 121 [58-256] pg/ml p<0.001）和较大的LA容积（38.5±11.5 vs 32.6±7.7 mL/m2，p<0.001）相关。

结论：在有症状的AF患者中，LASr降低与更晚期的心房心肌病相关，涉及血流动力学、机械和电学心房功能障碍。因此，LASr可能为AF中的心房心肌病提供一种有用的无创标志物。

title: Pulmonary vein narrowing after voltage-guided adjunctive pulmonary vein sleeve pulsed field ablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) for pulmonary vein (PV) isolation (PVI) has been associated with a low risk of PV stenosis when performed using the standard ostial workflow. However, the risk of PV narrowing after adjunctive PV sleeve PFA remains insufficiently evaluated.

OBJECTIVE: To assess PV narrowing after voltage-guided adjunctive PV sleeve PFA.

METHODS: We retrospectively studied 147 patients who underwent an initial pentaspline PFA-based PVI for atrial fibrillation. In addition to standard ostial PVI, voltage-guided PFA applications were delivered to target PV sleeve potentials identified on pre-ablation voltage mapping. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography was performed before and approximately six months after ablation. PV cross-sectional areas (PVAs) were measured at predefined levels, and the maximum PVA reduction rate was defined as ΔPVA. Significant PV narrowing was defined as ΔPVA ≥25%.

RESULTS: Post-ablation PVA was significantly smaller than pre-ablation PVA at all PV sites. The median ΔPVA was 5.4%, 6.4%, 4.6%, and 4.0% in the left superior, left inferior, right superior, and right inferior PVs, respectively, and differed significantly among the four PV sites (P = 0.012). No significant PV narrowing was observed in this cohort.

CONCLUSIONS: In patients undergoing an initial PFA-based PVI, no significant PV narrowing was observed approximately six months after voltage-guided adjunctive PV sleeve PFA using a pentaspline catheter. Further controlled studies with larger populations and longer follow-up are needed to better characterize the safety and clinical utility of this strategy.

AI.tldr: 在147例首次接受五分支PFA肺静脉隔离的房颤患者中，电压引导的附加肺静脉袖套PFA约6个月后未观察到显著肺静脉狭窄，各肺静脉最大横截面积缩小中位数为4.0%-6.4%。
AI.motivation: 标准开口部工作流程下的脉冲场消融（PFA）肺静脉隔离（PVI）肺静脉狭窄风险较低，但附加肺静脉袖套PFA后的肺静脉狭窄风险尚缺乏充分评估，本研究旨在填补这一安全性证据缺口。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入147例因房颤首次接受五分支PFA-based PVI的患者；在标准开口部PVI基础上，依据消融前电压标测识别的肺静脉袖套电位行电压引导的附加PFA。消融前及术后约6个月行增强CT，在预设水平测量肺静脉横截面积（PVA），以最大PVA缩小率（ΔPVA）为指标，显著肺静脉狭窄定义为ΔPVA≥25%。
AI.result: 术后各肺静脉PVA均显著小于术前。左上、左下、右上、右下肺静脉的ΔPVA中位数分别为5.4%、6.4%、4.6%、4.0%，四个肺静脉部位间差异有统计学意义（P=0.012）。本队列中未观察到显著肺静脉狭窄（ΔPVA≥25%）。
AI.conclusion: 首次PFA-based PVI患者接受五分支导管电压引导附加肺静脉袖套PFA后约6个月未见显著肺静脉狭窄，提示该策略短期安全性可接受；但本研究为回顾性、无对照、样本量有限且随访约6个月，其安全性与临床获益仍需更大样本、更长随访的对照研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：使用标准开口部工作流程进行肺静脉隔离（PVI）的脉冲场消融（PFA）与肺静脉（PV）狭窄的低风险相关。然而，辅助性肺静脉袖套PFA后肺静脉狭窄的风险仍评估不足。

目的：评估电压引导的辅助性肺静脉袖套PFA后的肺静脉狭窄。

方法：我们回顾性研究了147例因心房颤动接受首次五分支PFA-based PVI的患者。除标准开口部PVI外，根据消融前电压标测识别的靶向肺静脉袖套电位，施加电压引导的PFA应用。消融前和消融后约六个月进行对比增强计算机断层扫描。在预定水平测量肺静脉横截面积（PVAs），最大PVA减少率定义为ΔPVA。显著肺静脉狭窄定义为ΔPVA ≥25%。

结果：消融后PVA在所有肺静脉部位均显著小于消融前PVA。中位ΔPVA在左上、左下、右上和右下肺静脉分别为5.4%、6.4%、4.6%和4.0%，且在四个肺静脉部位间差异显著（P = 0.012）。本队列中未观察到显著肺静脉狭窄。

结论：在接受首次PFA-based PVI的患者中，使用五分支导管进行电压引导的辅助性肺静脉袖套PFA后约六个月，未观察到显著肺静脉狭窄。需要更大规模、更长随访的进一步对照研究，以更好地描述该策略的安全性和临床效用。

title: Zero-fluoroscopy approach to left atrial appendage closure using intracardiac echo guidance.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) with the Watchman™ device is typically performed with the use of transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) and fluoroscopy. LAAC guided by intracardiac echo (ICE) without the use of fluoroscopy has not been previously described.

OBJECTIVE: In this series, we describe the safety and feasibility of Watchman™ implantation using only ICE imaging and without the use of fluoroscopy.

METHODS: 214 patients undergoing LAAC with the Watchman FLX™ or Watchman FLX™ Pro device and using a planned fluoroscopy-free approach were studied. ICE was used for echocardiographic imaging in all cases. TEE was not used in any cases. Fluoroscopy was used as a bail-out approach when it was felt to be clinically necessary by the operator. Peri-procedural, 45-day, and 1-year efficacy and safety outcomes were assessed.

RESULTS: In 203/214 patients (94.8%), LAAC was completed without the use of fluoroscopy. Bail-out fluoroscopy was required in 11/214 patients (5.1%). Successful device implantation was completed in 212/214 patients (99.1%). The rate of any peri-device leak at 45 days post-procedure was 11.6%. Procedural complications were limited to one pericardial effusion and one case of ventricular tachycardia.

CONCLUSION: LAAC with the Watchman™ device using ICE imaging and without the use of fluoroscopy appears to be safe and effective. The rates of procedural success, complications, and peri-device leaks on 45 day follow up were consistent with that seen in pivotal clinical trials. Further studies are needed to assess the broader applicability of this technique.

AI.tldr: 本研究显示，在214例接受Watchman装置左心耳封堵术的患者中，采用心腔内超声引导且不使用透视的零透视方法，94.8%的病例成功完成，装置植入成功率99.1%，45天装置周围漏发生率为11.6%，围术期并发症仅2例，表明该技术安全可行。
AI.motivation: 左心耳封堵术通常需要经食管超声和透视引导，而完全无透视、仅用心腔内超声引导的方法尚未见报道。本研究旨在探讨这种零透视方法的安全性和可行性，以减少辐射暴露和TEE相关风险。
AI.method: 本研究为单中心回顾性病例系列，纳入214例计划采用无透视方法行Watchman FLX或Watchman FLX Pro装置左心耳封堵术的患者。所有病例使用心腔内超声进行超声成像，不使用经食管超声。当术者认为临床需要时，可改用透视作为补救措施。评估围术期、45天和1年的有效性和安全性终点。
AI.result: 203/214例（94.8%）患者在不使用透视的情况下完成左心耳封堵，11/214例（5.1%）需要补救性透视。装置植入成功率为212/214例（99.1%）。术后45天任何装置周围漏的发生率为11.6%。围术期并发症仅包括1例心包积液和1例室性心动过速。
AI.conclusion: 使用心腔内超声引导且无透视的Watchman装置左心耳封堵术看起来安全有效，其手术成功率、并发症和45天装置周围漏发生率与关键临床试验一致。需要进一步研究评估该技术的广泛适用性。

summary_zh:
背景：使用Watchman™装置进行左心耳封堵（LAAC）通常需要在经食管超声心动图（TEE）和透视引导下完成。此前尚未有报道描述仅在心腔内超声（ICE）引导下、不使用透视的LAAC。

目的：在本系列研究中，我们描述仅使用ICE成像、不使用透视进行Watchman™植入的安全性和可行性。

方法：研究纳入214例接受Watchman FLX™或Watchman FLX™ Pro装置进行LAAC并计划采用无透视策略的患者。所有病例均使用ICE进行超声心动图成像。任何病例均未使用TEE。当术者认为临床必要时，透视作为补救措施使用。评估了围手术期、45天和1年的有效性和安全性结局。

结果：在203/214例患者（94.8%）中，LAAC在不使用透视的情况下完成。11/214例患者（5.1%）需要补救性透视。212/214例患者（99.1%）成功完成装置植入。术后45天任何装置周围漏的发生率为11.6%。手术并发症仅限于1例心包积液和1例室性心动过速。

结论：使用ICE成像、不使用透视的Watchman™装置LAAC似乎是安全有效的。手术成功率、并发症发生率以及45天随访时的装置周围漏发生率与关键临床试验中所见一致。需要进一步研究以评估该技术的更广泛适用性。

title: Day-Night Patterns of Wearable-Derived Electrocardiographic Age and Left Atrial Remodeling in Atrial Fibrillation-Naïve Individuals.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Artificial intelligence-derived electrocardiographic (AI-ECG) age is conventionally treated as a static marker. Its diurnal dynamics and structural correlates in individuals without atrial fibrillation (AF) remain unknown.

OBJECTIVE: To characterize diurnal AI-ECG age patterns, their reproducibility, and associations with left atrial (LA) remodeling.

METHODS: We analyzed continuous wearable ECGs from two prospective registries (NCT05119725, NCT05355948). In 499 AF-naïve participants with ≥48-hour recordings, AI-ECG age was estimated every 10 minutes. Unsupervised clustering identified day-night trajectories, summarized by day-night difference (ΔAge) into Restorative (>0.6 years) or Disrupted (≤0.6 years) phenotypes. Reproducibility was evaluated across sequential periods. Age- and sex-adjusted associations of binary and continuous ΔAge with LA volume index (LAVI) were pooled in a cross-sectional echocardiographic substudy (n=122).

RESULTS: Three trajectories emerged in both registries. Restorative prevalence was 47.6%-50.2%. Agreement between two consecutive 48-hour periods was 75.8% (κ = 0.516; 95% CI, 0.395-0.631); 6- to 8-day intraclass correlation coefficients were 0.51-0.54. The Disrupted phenotype was associated with higher LAVI (pooled mean difference, 5.54 mL/m2; 95% CI, 1.11-9.98; P = .014) and greater odds of LA enlargement (LAVI ≥40 mL/m2; pooled odds ratio, 3.68; 95% CI, 1.45-9.29; P = .006). Per 1-SD higher ΔAge, LAVI was lower (β, -2.89 mL/m2; P = .007) and LA enlargement less likely (odds ratio, 0.53; P = .004).

CONCLUSION: Wearable-derived AI-ECG age exhibits a reproducible day-night pattern. A Disrupted phenotype is associated with adverse LA remodeling. Because reproducibility remains insufficient for individual-level classification, prospective outcome-based validation is warranted.

AI.tldr: 在499例无房颤者中，可穿戴AI-ECG年龄呈现可重复的昼夜节律，节律紊乱表型与左房扩大相关（OR 3.68），但个体分类可重复性不足。
AI.motivation: AI-ECG年龄通常被视为静态指标，其在无房颤人群中的昼夜动态变化、可重复性及与左房结构重构的关系尚不明确，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 分析两个前瞻性注册研究（NCT05119725、NCT05355948）中499例无房颤且记录≥48小时的可穿戴ECG，每10分钟估算AI-ECG年龄，无监督聚类识别昼夜轨迹，以昼夜差（ΔAge）分为恢复型（>0.6年）和紊乱型（≤0.6年）；评估连续48小时及6-8天的可重复性；在122例横断面超声亚组中，采用年龄和性别校正模型汇总ΔAge与左房容积指数（LAVI）的关联。
AI.result: 两个注册研究均识别出三种轨迹，恢复型占47.6%-50.2%。连续两个48小时期间一致率为75.8%（κ=0.516；95%CI 0.395-0.631），6-8天组内相关系数0.51-0.54。紊乱型与较高LAVI相关（汇总均差5.54 mL/m2；95%CI 1.11-9.98；P=0.014），左房扩大（LAVI≥40 mL/m2）的汇总OR为3.68（95%CI 1.45-9.29；P=0.006）。ΔAge每升高1个标准差，LAVI降低（β=-2.89 mL/m2；P=0.007），左房扩大风险降低（OR=0.53；P=0.004）。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴AI-ECG年龄呈现可重复的昼夜模式，节律紊乱表型与不良左房重构相关，提示其或可作为房颤基质早期标志；但个体层面分类可重复性不足，需前瞻性结局验证。

summary_zh:
背景：人工智能衍生的心电图（AI-ECG）年龄通常被视为静态标志物。其在无心房颤动（AF）个体中的昼夜动态变化及结构相关性尚不清楚。

目的：描述AI-ECG年龄的昼夜模式、其可重复性以及与左心房（LA）重构的关联。

方法：我们分析了来自两个前瞻性注册研究（NCT05119725、NCT05355948）的连续可穿戴心电图。在499名记录时间≥48小时的无AF参与者中，每10分钟估算一次AI-ECG年龄。无监督聚类识别出昼夜轨迹，通过昼夜差异（ΔAge）归纳为恢复型（>0.6年）或紊乱型（≤0.6年）表型。在连续时间段内评估可重复性。在横断面超声心动图亚研究（n=122）中，汇总了二元和连续ΔAge与左心房容积指数（LAVI）的年龄和性别校正关联。

结果：两个注册研究中均出现三种轨迹。恢复型患病率为47.6%-50.2%。两个连续48小时时间段之间的一致性为75.8%（κ = 0.516；95% CI，0.395-0.631）；6至8天的组内相关系数为0.51-0.54。紊乱型表型与较高的LAVI相关（汇总平均差，5.54 mL/m2；95% CI，1.11-9.98；P = .014），且左心房增大（LAVI ≥40 mL/m2）的几率更高（汇总比值比，3.68；95% CI，1.45-9.29；P = .006）。ΔAge每增加1个标准差，LAVI较低（β，-2.89 mL/m2；P = .007），左心房增大的可能性较小（比值比，0.53；P = .004）。

结论：可穿戴设备衍生的AI-ECG年龄表现出可重复的昼夜模式。紊乱型表型与不良左心房重构相关。由于可重复性仍不足以进行个体水平分类，有必要进行基于结局的前瞻性验证。

title: Epicardial Closure for Peridevice Leaks from Endocardial Left Atrial Appendage Closure - Early LARIAT-4-PDL Registry Results.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Closure of clinically significant peri-device leaks (PDLs) after left atrial appendage (LAA) occlusion remains crucial to prevent thromboembolism. A variety of techniques exist to close PDLs, each with its own advantages and disadvantages. The LARIAT (Atricure, Mason, OH) suture device may provide an alternative for closing PDLs.

OBJECTIVE: We report the initial feasibility of LARIAT for endocardial LAA closure PDLs.

METHODS: In a multicenter, retrospective study, we reviewed consecutive patients who underwent LARIAT for closure of device-related LAA leaks. All patients had PDLs ≥3 mm after either a Watchman FLX Pro (Boston Scientific, Marlborough, MA) or an Amplatzer Amulet (Abbott, Chicago, IL) endocardial LAA occluder, as seen on postoperative imaging. Acute PDL closure - pericardial access with device deployment and elimination of the PDL on intraprocedural imaging - was evaluated with either transesophageal or intracardiac echocardiogram, along with 45-day safety.

RESULTS: We report 10 cases in patients aged 67.2±10.7years, 30.0% female, and with a body mass index 32.4±6.4 kg/m2. Baseline comorbidities included a CHADSVASC of 4.4±0.7 and HASBLED of 3.7±0.7.
